jobs.title: Young Professional Track .NET
C#.NET Applicatie Ontwikkelaar – EPD
jobs.description:
Binnen een dynamisch Scrum team werken aan een SaaS applicatie voor de zorgsector. Gebruikersvriendelijke en proces ondersteunende software ontwikkelen van ontwerp, softwareontwikkeling tot aan eindtesten met de nieuwste technologie gestoeld op generieke en een uniek en flexibel metadata-drive databasesoftware framework.

Functie

Wij zijn op zoek naar een Applicatie Ontwikkelaar die zich kan verplaatsen in (de organisatie van) de gebruiker, kan meedenken met het projectteam, enthousiast wordt van het realiseren van flexibel en generiek gebouwde software innovaties die dagelijks gebruikt worden en zowel in teamverband als zelfstandig goed kan werken. Je wordt onderdeel van het ontwikkelteam waarmee je op basis van C#.NET en een geoctrooieerd technologisch framework bouwt aan een innovatief online EPD, genaamd Curasoft, welke binnen toonaangevende organisaties in Nederland wordt gebruikt.

Vanaf het ontwerp tot en met de technische test ben je verantwoordelijk voor de realisatie van een stuk functionaliteit. Ervaring met ontwikkelen binnen de zorgsector is een pre.

Taken

Het betreft een functie voor minimaal 32 tot bij voorkeur 40 uur per week. De meest voorkomende taken zijn:

Ontwikkelen en bouwen aan de software, zowel nieuwe functionaliteit als onderhoud aan bestaande.
Documenteren en beheren van de technologie die in de software wordt toegepast.
Het proactief inspelen op ICT ontwikkelingen in de markt en het zorgdragen voor een juiste vertaling hiervan naar de interne organisatie;
Testen en het correct opleveren zijn een logisch gevolg van jouw werk;
In deze rol heb je geen directe communicatie met de klanten zelf, maar met de interne afdelingen productmanagement en accountmanagement.

Functie eisen

Aantoonbaar HBO of WO IT opleiding of met flinke IT component;
Minimaal 3 jaar werkervaring in soortgelijke software ontwikkeling;
Ervaring met de volgende technologie en methoden:

C#.NET, MS SQL, Angular, Entity Framework, MVC, UML, WPF, Agile, Scrum, Webservices, JSON, XML

Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal (woord en geschrift);
Prestaties kunnen leveren in een dynamische werkomgeving;
Zowel een proactieve als een resultaatgerichte werkhouding;
Probleemoplossend vermogen;
Cijfermatig en analytisch onderlegd;
Luisteren, creatief zijn, doorzetten, gestructureerd werken zijn jouw eigenschappen.

Pre’s

Ervaring met ontwikkeling binnen de zorg sector;
Ervaring met Zorg, DBC, ZIB en/of FHIR ontwikkeling en/of kennis van zorg terminologie;
Kennis over/ervaring met AWS en Azure cloud en Azuredevops

Wat Bieden Wij Jou

De groei, toekomstverwachtingen en technologische ontwikkelingen bieden een omgeving waar tal van mogelijkheden zijn om jezelf te ontwikkelen, zowel op persoonlijk als op technisch gebied.

Een Greep Uit Ons Aanbod

Continu uitdaging in je werk is een belofte
Werken aan hoogstaande software gebaseerd op geoctrooieerd framework
Werkplek uitkijkend op Zaans Erfgoed – Zaanse Schans!
Werken aan uitdagende projecten voor aansprekende klanten
Een uitstekend arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket
Bedrijfsfitness (vrijblijvend)
Personal Trainer 1 x per week in de fitness (vrijblijvend)
Informele werkomgeving in een open en eerlijk team met een kennis gedreven, resultaatgerichte en innovatieve instelling
Regelmatig gezellige borrels in onze eigen bar
Daag je collega’s uit met een potje poolen, darten of tafeltennis in de pauze

Ter conclusie: herken jij je in deze functie? Stuur dan jouw motivatiebrief met CV, onder vermelding van C#.NET Applicatie Ontwikkelaar, naar recruitment@curasoft.nl

NB Acquisitie n.a.v. deze vacatures wordt niet op prijs gesteld.
Toegezonden profielen worden als directe sollicitatie vanuit de kandidaat beschouwd en eventueel zo behandeld.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Developer(EN)
jobs.description:
Create your own future

As a Senior Full Stack Developer, you will help build digital solutions that support wealth planners in guiding clients through one of life's most important decisions: planning the transfer of wealth across generations.

ClientCenter is the central platform used by our commercial colleagues and is being extended with new capabilities that help wealth planners better understand client situations, streamline succession planning processes, and provide more personalised advice. Your work will directly contribute to improving how our colleagues support clients in achieving their long-term wealth goals.

This is a highly collaborative role where technology, business expertise and user needs come together. We believe the best products are built by teams that stay close to their users. That's why we're looking for someone who is curious, user-oriented and eager to understand both the business domain and the people who use the software every day.

Your responsibilities:

Design, build and maintain scalable applications and services
Develop end-to-end solutions using modern full stack technologies
Work closely with wealth planners to understand user workflows, validate assumptions and deliver solutions that create measurable value
Translate complex wealth and succession planning requirements into robust, secure and maintainable software
Develop a deep understanding of the Belgian wealth and succession planning domain and actively contribute to shaping digital solutions in this space
Collaborate with other development teams within the cluster to deliver seamless and integrated client journeys
Contribute to architecture decisions, technical design and the evolution of the platform
Leverage AI throughout the entire software development lifecycle while maintaining high standards for quality, security, and maintainability
Take ownership from analysis through implementation and release
Continuously improve development practices, testing approaches and system reliability
Coach and support junior team members through knowledge sharing, feedback and technical guidance

Your talents

As a Senior Full Stack Developer, you combine strong technical expertise with curiosity for the business domain and the people who use the products you build. You take ownership, communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and are comfortable working in complex environments where business and technology intersect.

In addition, you have:

At least 5 years of experience as a Full Stack Developer
Strong experience with C# .NET, Angular, and modern web development technologies
Experience working with Azure-based solutions
A pragmatic approach to AI-assisted software development, balancing productivity gains with sound engineering judgement
Strong collaboration skills and experience working across multiple teams and stakeholders
A strong interest in understanding end-user workflows and improving the user experience
The ability to quickly understand complex functional domains and translate them into technical solutions
Excellent communication skills and experience working in Agile teams

Move ahead at Van Lanschot Kempen

Investing in a more future-oriented, sustainable, and data-driven way with various clients. Both nationally and internationally. With nearly 300 years of experience, we make this ambition a reality at Van Lanschot Kempen. We do this with more than 2,100 colleagues in various fields of expertise.

You will join a Scrum team that develops and evolves digital solutions supporting wealth and succession planning within the Private Clients domain. Working across the full stack, you will help create solutions that simplify complex processes and support colleagues in delivering high-quality advice to clients. You'll have the opportunity to influence technical decisions, contribute to product evolution and help establish best practices within the team.

An organisation's degree of innovation and agility also depends on the diversity of its workforce. Our differences make us stronger together. We promote an inclusive work environment where all colleagues feel at home. With us, you can be yourself. And we are proud of that.

Curious about the stories of colleagues and how they experience working at Van Lanschot Kempen? Go to Podcasts and find out more

That is what we do! The fact is, if you add value, you can expect the same from us in return. A good work-life balance with our ‘hybrid way of working’ is a good example of this. As a Senior Full Stack Developer, you will also be given: 

a gross monthly salary between €5.500 and €7.000, depending on knowledge and experience
a flexible budget of 19.47% of your gross salary (including 13th month, 8% holiday pay, and 7 extra days off), to be spent on things like a bike, gym, or sabbatical
hybrid working with flexibility, with the team typically working from the Amsterdam office on Tuesdays and Thursdays
27 vacation days, including 7 within the flexible budget
a competitive pension scheme, with an average employer contribution of around 20%
the opportunity to work abroad for up to 2 months per year
a fully equipped home office setup, including an electric standing desk, ergonomic chair and monitors, delivered to your home
working from home allowance
an employee share plan, where Van Lanschot Kempen matches your investment in Van Lanschot Kempen shares up to €3,500 per year
Dutch and English language courses
extensive training opportunities and room for personal and professional development
weekly drinks at our bar in the office
discounted collective health insurance
chair massage and physio at the office

And many more employment benefits ready for you.  Discover all the benefits of working at Van Lanschot Kempen.

Excited about this opportunity? Apply through our website.

If you have any questions, feel free to contact Anna Skorobohata, Recruiter at a.skorobohata@vanlanschotkempen.com

jobs.title: Integration Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Heb jij ervaring met cloud-native architecturen en integratieoplossingen? Ben jij degene die technische uitdagingen aangaat en deze vertaalt in praktische en schaalbare toepassingen? Wil jij jouw (AI) kennis inzetten om innovatieve oplossingen te realiseren? Dan zoeken wij jou als Integration Software Developer binnen ons Integratie Team bij Rensa Family Company.

Rensa Family Company is een groeiende organisatie binnen de technische groothandel waar efficiëntie en innovatie centraal staan. Als Software Developer werk je mee aan de doorontwikkeling van ons Hybrid Integration Platform (HIP). Dit platform speelt een belangrijke rol in het verbinden van onze IT-systemen en het ondersteunen van onze bedrijfsprocessen.

Jouw expertise en visie zorgen ervoor dat we ons integratielandschap moderniseren en toekomstbestendig maken. Samen met het team ontwikkel je oplossingen voor complexe IT-vraagstukken en help je onze organisatie verder te digitaliseren.

Wat doet het Hybrid Integration Platform (HIP)?

Het Hybrid Integration Platform is ontworpen om applicaties op een gestandaardiseerde, schaalbare en onderhoudbare manier te integreren. Het biedt een cloud-native foundation die zowel cloud-based als on-premise systemen bindt in een event-driven architectuur.

Met technologieën zoals Azure Service Bus, Docker, ASP.NET Core Web API en Azure Functions, helpt HIP ons om integratiecomplexiteit te verminderen, ontwikkelingscycli te versnellen en flexibele samenwerking tussen onze systemen mogelijk te maken.

Jouw rol als Engineer

Als Integration Software Engineer draag je verantwoordelijkheid voor:

Ontwerp en ontwikkeling: Het ontwerpen, realiseren en optimaliseren van HIP-componenten zoals adapters, services en event-driven messaging.
Samenwerking binnen het team: Je werkt nauw samen met collega-developers, architecten en andere stakeholders om kwalitatieve integratieoplossingen te realiseren.
Standaardisatie en kwaliteit: Je ontwikkelt oplossingen volgens de geldende integratiestandaarden, waaronder het gebruik van het Rensa Data Model (RDM) en Canonical Data Models.
Samenwerking met business en IT-stakeholders: Je vertaalt zakelijke behoeften naar technische oplossingen en werkt samen aan het verbeteren van processen en technologieën
Continue verbetering: Je blijft op de hoogte van ontwikkelingen binnen integratie- en cloudtechnologieën en draagt actief bij aan het verbeteren van bestaande oplossingen en ontwikkelprocessen.
Toepassen van AI: Je zet AI-tools in om ontwikkeling, testen, documentatie en analyse van integratieoplossingen efficiënter en kwalitatief beter uit te voeren.
Testen en beheer: Je bent betrokken bij het testen, documenteren, monitoren en onderhouden van integratieoplossingen om een stabiele en betrouwbare dienstverlening te waarborgen.

Technologieën waarmee je gaat werken

.NET (C#)
Azure Service Bus
Azure API Management
Azure Functions
ASP.NET Web API
Azure CosmosDB
Azure Storage-accounts
Azure SQL
Azure Container Apps
Docker (en Kubernetes via Azure Container Apps Environment)
KEDA voor event-driven autoscaling
Azure DevOps
AI tooling: GitHub, Copilot, chatGPT, Codex etc.

Wat maakt jou een goede kandidaat om ons team te versterken?

(Ruime) ervaring met softwareontwikkeling, bij voorkeur in .NET (C#);
Ervaring met het Azure platform en Azure Services zoals Service Bus, API Management, CosmosDB, Storage Accounts en Functions;
Het begrijpen en toepassen van containertechnologieën (bijv. Docker) en cloud-native principes;
Kennis van event-driven architecturen en publish/subscribe messaging;
Ervaring met het implementeren en beheren van RESTful APIs en API-gateways.
In staat om effectief samen te werken binnen een multidisciplinair ontwikkelteam en kennis te delen met collega’s.
Leergierig en continu gericht op het verbeteren van kennis en codekwaliteit.

Wat hebben wij jou te bieden?

Wij bieden wij een heel mooi pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden:

Salaris tussen de €4.000,- en €5.500,- bruto per maand, afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring.
40 vrije dagen op fulltime basis, waarvan 28 vakantiedagen en 12 verlofdagen;
Een innovatieve werkomgeving waar jouw ideeën en technische expertise gewaardeerd worden.
Een organisatie met een visie en focus op duurzaamheid en lange termijn impact;
Vooroplopen in je vak. Je werkt met de nieuwste technologie, samenwerken met sterke partners en ervaren collega’s;
Goede verhouding tussen thuiswerken en op kantoor;
Deelname aan een target- en winstregeling;
Een premievrije pensioenregeling met mogelijkheid zelf extra bij te sparen;
Fijne werksfeer met betrokken collega’s, leuke teamactiviteiten en een actieve personeelsvereniging – work hard, have fun! “We have fun working together” staat niet voor niets in onze strategie.
Sterke laptop en telefoon van de zaak.
Tegemoetkoming reiskosten woon-werkverkeer van € 0.25 per kilometer.

Rensa Family. Groots worden doe je samen.

Werken onder de paraplu van Rensa Family betekent samen met je collega’s bouwen aan stabiele groei. We willen samen met jou de beste partner van de installateur zijn op het gebied van expertise, technisch advies en logistiek. Je krijgt alle ruimte voor persoonlijke groei, ontwikkeling en welzijn. Zodat je trots kunt zijn op je werk, jezelf en je team: samen naar steeds betere, duurzame resultaten! Voor jou als talent of professional en voor Rensa Family als bedrijf. Word wat je wilt, blijf gewoon jezelf. Rensa Family. Groots worden doe je samen.

Klaar om impact te maken?

Solliciteer vandaag nog en word onderdeel van Rensa Family! Heb je inhoudelijke vragen over de functie? Ronald Heutinck, Tech lead, beantwoordt met plezier je vragen. Ronald is te bereiken op 06-13981205.

jobs.title: Senior Full-stack Software Engineer (Integrations)
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer
to join the Integrations team at DataSnipper. The Integrations team builds the connectors that let people and AI agents work directly with the systems a business runs on — ERPs, accounting systems, general ledgers. We make that access simple, secure, and reliable, so our customers spend their time on the work itself rather than on getting data out of their systems.

You will work across the stack, C#/.NET on the server side, TypeScript/React on the front end, and Python for AI-powered services, building features that auditors trust with their most critical work.

This is a delivery-focused role for an engineer who is excited to make impact and grow in a team that ships fast, holds a high quality bar, and uses AI to accelerate development.

About DataSnipper

DataSnipper is the driving force behind an intelligent automation platform that’s transforming the world of audit and finance.

Founded in 2017, DataSnipper has skyrocketed and is now OFFICIALLY the fastest-growing software company in the Netherlands according to Deloitte Fast50 and recently achieved Unicorn status in our latest funding round. With over 400.000 users in 125+ countries and a second base in the heart of New York City, DataSnipper is shaking things up. And we’re not stopping there. At DataSnipper, we’re always on the lookout for innovators who think outside of the box. New ideas aren’t just welcomed at DataSnipper–they’re essential.

What You Will Do

Technical Delivery

Build and maintain the connectors and services that pull data from ERPs, accounting systems, and general ledgers into DataSnipper, in C# / .NET, TypeScript, and Python.
Design the data models and mappings that turn each source system's schema into a consistent shape our product and AI agents can rely on.
Own new connector integrations end to end: research the source system's API and auth, build the connector and its agent tools and MCP surface, test against real customer data, and support it after launch.
Build the tooling and observability that keeps connectors reliable as source systems change their APIs underneath us.
Implement authentication and data handling controls that meet customer security expectations for access to their financial systems.

Quality, Reliability & On-Call

Write robust, well-tested, production-ready code, unit, integration, and end-to-end tests are part of the deliverable, not an afterthought.
Participate in code reviews as both author and reviewer, help maintain coding standards and design patterns across the team.
Participate in on-call rotation

Collaboration & Impact

Use AI-assisted engineering effectively and responsibly, critically evaluating AI output.
Partner with product managers, designers, ML engineers, and QA to refine requirements, surface edge cases, and ship features
Break down stories, estimate work realistically, and deliver against sprint commitments with limited supervision.
Contribute to technical design discussions, propose pragmatic solutions and challenge assumptions when it helps the team.

What You Will Bring

Must-Have

Minimum of 5 years of experience building applications using a modern stack built with .NET
Hands-on experience with TypeScript and a modern front-end framework
Proficiency with AI-assisted engineering tools
Experience with relational and document-based databases.
Strong experience building, deploying, and maintaining APIs
Experience with Azure and Docker is required
Knowledge of Event-Driven Architecture and DDD principles
Passionate about high-quality coding standards and testing of code
Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to work effectively in an ever-changing scale-up environment
Strong communication and collaboration skills in English, both written and verbal.

Nice-to-Have

Experience building or integrating with AI agentic applications in production (LLM orchestration, RAG, evals, prompt engineering).
Experience with document processing (OCR, PDF extraction, Azure Document Intelligence, layout parsing).
Domain experience in audit, accounting, or fintech.
Exposure to Event-Driven Architecture and Domain-Driven Design principles.

What We Expect

Ownership: You take features from refinement to production and stay accountable through bug-bashing, on-call response, and follow-ups. You don't wait to be told what to fix.
Growth Mindset: You actively seek and give feedback, and treat reviews and pairing sessions as a chance to grow rather than to defend.
Collaboration: You build trust with product, design, QA, and fellow engineers; you ask good questions and share context generously.
Adaptability: You feel comfortable in a fast-changing scale-up environment, priorities shift, scope sharpens, and you help the team adjust.
Judgment: You balance speed and quality, know when to push back, when to ship pragmatically, and when to escalate.

What We Offer

Being part of one of the fastest-growing scale-ups in the Netherlands
Make an impact by disrupting the audit industry with us
28 vacation days
Excellent salary
Pension plan
Stock participation plan
Hybrid work (Amsterdam-based)
International team and environment
Daily lunch 🍽️
Mental health support (OpenUp)
Social events and team activities 🤩

Recruitment steps

Recruiter screen
Hiring Manager interview
Peer programming session
System design interview
Final interviews with Engineering leadership

At DataSnipper, we believe great ideas come from different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. We’re committed to building an inclusive workplace and providing a fair and equitable hiring experience for every candidate.

We welcome applicants regardless of age, race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes you, you.

What matters to us is your potential, your experience, and what you can bring to the team!

and web application development.

Key Accountabilities

Translate application storyboards and use cases into functional applications.
Design, build and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable code.
Ensure the best possible performance, quality and responsiveness of the applications.
Collaborate closely with the Product Owner to ensure alignment with business requirements and meet delivery timelines.
Prioritize and facilitate the early resolution of client issues, ensuring adherence to agreed Service Level Agreements (SLA).
Conduct code reviews, contribute to critical feature designs, and ensure the overall quality of the team's deliverables.
Flag technical debt and areas of improvements, making sure they are properly documented and taken into account when defining priorities.
Implement a robust documentation system for knowledge base, onboarding, knowledge transfer, and communication in software development activities.
Identify bottlenecks and bugs and devise solutions to these problems.
Follow Agile Scrum development process for application development.

Knowledge, Personality, Skills And Experience Required

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
Experience in iOS development development is required.
Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience in .NET development.
Proficient in C#, APS.NET and .NET Core.
Strong knowledge of AWS and/or Azure, Microservices architecture, and design patterns.
Strong knowledge of containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes.
Experience in Entity Framework/EF Core is a strong plus.
Experience in frontend technologies like React.js or Angular is a strong plus.
Experience in NodeJs is a plus.
Solid grasp of security best practices related to APIs and data privacy.
Proficiency in Agile/Scrum methodologies and a commitment to driving Agile practices within the team.
Comfortable with DevOps practices involving configuration management, CI/CD pipelines, Gitflow, IaC, deployment patterns among others.
Excellent problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to addressing challenges.
Proficiency in English is a must.

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Developer
jobs.description:
As a full-stack developer you work hard on making Independer.nl better, faster and responsive. You don't do this alone, but always within one of our 9 (international) scrum teams. Our multidisciplinary teams consist of developers (front and back end), testers, designers and product owners. Together you tackle several major key projects and our ongoing migration to the cloud.

You can count on working with tools and techniques like C#, .NET 10, Angular 19 onwards, TypeScript (JavaScript), Nx and SASS. And after our migration to the cloud we're focusing on Azure, App Services en YAML pipelines.

Specifically:
You want to make a valuable contribution to the website
– you contribute from your expertise, plan and execute own tasks, respect the 'Definition of Ready' and the 'Definition of Done'. You understand stakeholder and customer requirements.
You want to grow your expertise
– we help by providing an environment where you are allowed to make mistakes, a personal growth budget, lots of freedom and colleagues you can learn from.
You strive for predictability & stability
– you deliver reliable, high quality software. You bring working software to production while improving the way we work. The deliverables are aligned with our product strategy and seen from a customer perspective.
In addition to being a team player, you also like autonomy
– you want to grow in your area of expertise, but understand the challenges faced by other areas of expertise and how different areas of expertise can best work together. Furthermore, you are curious about the Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) aspects for your own area of expertise.
You are open to using AI tools in your daily work -
and know how to apply them in a supportive and responsible way to improve efficiency, quality and collaboration, while always maintaining human ownership and final responsibility over the output.
You always go for an optimal customer experience (just like us)
– and that with an impact of millions of visitors a year.

Why Independer?

Despite the fact that we belong in the list of the largest online platforms in the Netherlands (such as bol.com, coolblue and takeaway) Independer is still a relatively small club of around 250 specialists. This makes our culture flexible, open and lively. A flat hierarchy in which freedom and daring are central.

The technical environment that we offer is complex, challenging and constantly changing. We want the best (online) environment for both our customers and our colleagues. This means that the focus is on 'getting the latest and greatest tech'. We focus on .NET Core, Azure (DevOps) and Angular (19.0). And in case we missed anything, we look forward to your input!

The fact that we've been around for 25 years is thanks to our open, relaxed culture and our colleagues. True Independers think in terms of possibilities, dare to make mistakes and help each other. All that in an environment where you can play pool or darts in your breaks and where no one is surprised if you walk into our office in Hilversum in your shorts or flip-flops.

Some of your colleagues have been proud Independers for years and that is not without reason: Independer is constantly developing and you grow with us. That makes you the owner of your own career.

What we're looking for in a new colleague?

You're 5+ years active as a Fullstack Developer/ Software Engineer.
You have a good understanding of Internet technology and software development in general (C#, .NET, ASP.NET MVC, OOP, SQL etc.)
In terms of frontend, you bring experience and interest in Angular (modern), Javascript and Typescript.
You are a strong team player who enjoys collaborating, sharing knowledge and supporting colleagues.
You take initiative, you are stress resistant and accurate.
You are eager to get started, but always want to know the why.
Furthermore, we find it important that you can teach us something and can enthusiastically tell us about other projects you've done.
A big advantage would be if you have experience with: .NET CORE, Azure and StoryBook.

What do you get from us?

A salary between €5000 and €7200 gross per month (excluding vacation pay and annual bonus)
A premium free-of-contribution pensionplan, 30 vacation days, travel allowance and a home office and internet allowance.
Flexibility in working hours, and the possibility to work 50% from home (and even several weeks a year from abroad).
Lots of room to grow and develop - through our Independer-wide training offer or on an individual level.
Fun events, drinks and various (bi-)weekly sports activities.
An extensive, fresh and healthy lunch in our company bakery every day.
A nice office -with free parking- full of enthusiastic colleagues, at the edge of the Hilversum Mediapark.

Interested? Great! Let us know who you are and apply now!

jobs.title: Azure Cloud Developer
jobs.description:
Als Cloud Developer – Azure Integration Services bouw je moderne, schaalbare en veilige integratieoplossingen op het Microsoft Azure platform. Je werkt aan het ontsluiten en verbinden van bedrijfskritische applicaties via API’s, event‑gedreven integraties en geautomatiseerde workflows.

Je combineert low‑code (Logic Apps) met high‑code (Azure Functions in C#) en zorgt samen met architecten en DevOps‑teams voor oplossingen die veilig, toekomstvast en beheersbaar zijn binnen een enterprise context.

Werkzaamheden & verantwoordelijkheden

Ontwikkeling & integratie

Ontwikkelen van cloud‑native integratieoplossingen op basis van Azure Integration Services.
Bouwen en onderhouden van REST API’s met Azure Functions (C#/.NET) en ontsluiten via Azure API Management (inclusief policies, versioning en throttling).
Ontwerpen en implementeren van workflow‑ en procesautomatisering met Azure Logic Apps (standard).
Implementeren van event‑gedreven en asynchrone integraties met Azure Service Bus, Event Grid en storage‑events.
Realiseren van data‑transformaties, validaties en verrijking binnen integraties (JSON, XML, mapping).

Architectuur en Integratie

Toepassen van gangbare integratie‑ en API‑patronen (request/reply, publish/subscribe, event‑driven, API‑led connectivity).
Meedenken over herbruikbare bouwblokken, naming conventions en integratiestandaarden.
Samenwerken met solution- en integratiearchitecten bij het vertalen van architectuur naar concrete implementatie.

Security, betrouwbaarheid & performance

Implementeren van security‑by‑design: OAuth2, Managed Identities, Entra ID, Key Vault en API‑beveiliging.
Inrichten van logging, monitoring en alerting met Application Insights, Azure monitor en Log Analytics.
Borgen van betrouwbaarheid, schaalbaarheid en performance van integraties (retry‑mechanismen, dead‑lettering, timeouts).

DevOps & lifecycle management

Werken volgens CI/CD‑principes met Azure DevOps of GitHub (pipelines, releases, branching).
Bijdragen aan Infrastructure as Code (AVM/Bicep) en geautomatiseerde deployments.
Onderhouden en verbeteren van bestaande integraties gedurende de volledige lifecycle (build–run–change).

Samenwerking & Agile werken

Actief deelnemen aan Scrum / Agile teams en bijdragen aan refinement, sprintplanning en demos.
Afstemmen met consultants, product owners en stakeholders over functionele en niet‑functionele eisen.
Documenteren van oplossingen en kennisdeling binnen het team.

Wat bieden we jou?

Competitief salaris en een jaarlijkse bonus op basis van bedrijfs-, team- en individuele prestaties;
25 vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid tot 35 dagen;
Hybride werken: kantoor in Amsterdam, Rotterdam of Veenendaal + thuiswerkmogelijkheden;
Vitaliteitsbudget van €65,- netto per maand, leasefietsplan en een veilige, gezonde werkomgeving;
Persoonlijke ontwikkeling via HSO Academy, studiebudget en toegang tot GoodHabitz;
Teamuitjes, borrels, sportactiviteiten en deelname aan maatschappelijk verantwoord ondernemen-projecten.

Over HSO

HSO is de eerste full-service Microsoft Partner in Nederland. Met meer dan 2500 professionals wereldwijd ondersteunen we bedrijven in Retail, Manufacturing, Financial Services, Professional Services en de publieke sector. We brengen geïntegreerde Microsoft-platformen tot leven, waaronder Dynamics 365 en Cloud & Data-oplossingen. Bij HSO werk je in een internationale omgeving waar leren, innoveren en samenwerken centraal staan.

Develop integration components such as schemas, mappings, pipelines, and orchestrations in BizTalk and Azure services
Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and integrate third-party services
Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to team members
Write and maintain technical documentation

What do we expect from you?

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in an Informatics or IT-related field
Proven experience as an integration developer
Experience with Microsoft BizTalk and/or Azure integration services
Experience with EDI (X12, EDIFACT), XML, JSON integrations
Strong knowledge of integration patterns (Pub/Sub, Scatter-Gather, Split/Aggregate)
Experience with Agile development methodologies
Experience with version control systems (Git)
Knowledge of C#

Currently living in The Netherlands within commuting distance of Haarlem

Experience with API management, preferably using Apigee
Experience with cloud platforms (Azure)

jobs.title: Project Engineer
Automation Engineer- System Integration (OT/IT)
jobs.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.

About The Katwijk Site

This position starts with a 12-month contract, with the intention of offering a permanent contract based on mutual fit. (Dienstverband: tijdelijk met uitzicht op vast)

Eli Lilly is investing €2.6 billion in a new state-of-the-art manufacturing facility in Katwijk, Netherlands. This facility will produce oral medicines for cardiometabolic health, neuroscience, oncology, and immunology, incorporating next-generation manufacturing technologies including dock-to-dock automation, paperless manufacturing, and process analytical technology while achieving carbon neutrality and zero waste to landfills.

Position Overview

The Automation Integration System Admin will enable information and data flow between Manufacturing Science, Quality, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Operations by leveraging IT and Process Automation Technologies. This role will support innovation evaluation and application for Manufacturing Process Automation and IT Systems with a focus on Rockwell based FactoryTalk View HMI/SCADA Platforms, Lilly’s OT/IT integration layer, data integrity and end-point cyber security solutions

During the design and delivery of the project this role will be integrated into the global automation team and then transition fully to a site-based process team position. 

Key Responsibilities

Partner with Corporate Automation, Automation Integrators, and Global Facilities delivery to design, install, and qualify the site Rockwell based FactoryTalk View HMI/SCADA Platforms, Lilly’s OT/IT integration layer, and end-point cyber security solutions
System Administration ownership of these platforms post-delivery including user access controls, life cycle management, process improvements, data management, and system maintenance.
Manage and own the system security including data integrity.
Perform audits and periodic assessments of the systems to ensure compliance with Global Quality and Engineering Standards.
Lead the management and growth of the platforms and support of manufacturing process teams as new systems are added to the facility.
Partner with Corporate Automation, Information Technology, and Information Security for global initiatives and life cycle management.
Develop site procedures that will govern the automation integration systems.

Qualifications & Requirements

Education

Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related science field
Professional fluency in English

Experience/Technical Knowledge

5+ years in automation.
5+ years in pharmaceutical or other regulated industries. 
Knowledge of GMPs, regulatory requirements, computer system validation.
Experience with Rockwell Automation platforms including FactoryTalk View SE distributed and ControlLogix/CompactLogix PLCs or other similar automation technologies.
Experience in ISA S95 Manufacturing Enterprise IT/Automation integration principles.
Experience in managing IT/OT platforms.

Additional Skills/Preferences

Experience in IT Infrastructure and Networking
Experience in Citrix Application publishing
Experience in virtual environments (VMware)
Experience with Data Historians or related technology.
Experience in Microsoft operating systems, virtual environments, and networking.
Experience in manufacturing connectivity software (i.e., OPC Server such as Kepware, Matrikon)
Experience in relational enterprise databases (i.e., SQL Server).

Interpersonal Skills

Excellent written and verbal communication skills for internal customers, business partners, and leadership
Ability to work with minimal supervision, manage competing priorities, and drive results in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
Ability to collaborate with others.
Strong decision-making, problem-solving, and organisational skills.

On-site Requirement

This is 100% full-time on-site role

Travel requirements
–

We typically expect travel to be 10-20% during the design and delivery phase for engineering meetings, training, and job shadowing opportunities.

Eli Lilly and Company | Katwijk, Netherlands

jobs.title: Automation Engineer
Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
“Bij Klipboard werken we met een flexibel thuiswerk beleid, waarbij medewerkers drie dagen op kantoor werken en twee dagen thuis. Deze aanpak bevordert een evenwichtige werkomgeving die samenwerking op kantoor combineert met het comfort en gemak van werken op afstand.”

Kom werken als Software Engineer bij Klipboard

Locatie:
Gouda of Den Bosch (Nederland)

Aantal uren per week:
Fulltime

Wil jij werken in een innovatieve omgeving waar (internationale) samenwerking centraal staat? Dan is werken bij Klipboard de volgende stap in je carrière!

Klipboard is marktleider in cloud-based bedrijfsmanagement software voor branchespecifieke organisaties in de distributie, automotive, field services, verhuur, retail en meer. Met meer dan 52.000 klanten wereldwijd en meer dan 1.670 medewerkers maken we een spannende transformatie door: een nieuw merk, nieuwe digitale ervaringen en een gedurfde ambitie om voorop te lopen met design.

Klipboard is een wereldwijd groeiend bedrijf dat AI en opkomende technologieën omarmt om klantresultaten, samenwerking en voortdurende verbetering te versterken. We zijn op zoek naar mensen die nieuwsgierig zijn naar of vertrouwd zijn met AI, openstaan voor verandering en enthousiast zijn om te leren hoe technologie ons werk kan verbeteren en onze klanten kan helpen — altijd ondersteund door sterke menselijke inzichten en communicatie.

Werken bij Klipboard betekent werken in een persoonlijke, open en informele werkomgeving, waar ieders idee telt en iedereen elkaar echt kent. Of je nu aan het begin van je carrière staat of al veel ervaring hebt opgedaan, bij ons krijg je de ruimte om te leren en te groeien op een manier die jij wilt: verdiepen, verbreden of gewoon van 9 tot 5 werken, het kan en het mag allemaal.

Jouw toekomstige rol als Software Engineer

Ons Software Development team is klaar om zijn volgende kampioen te verwelkomen! We zoeken een pro-actieve, gemotiveerde en gepassioneerde Software Engineer
.

Je Wordt Opgeleid Door Ons Team Van ERP-experts In Het Pakket AGP Trade. Naast AGP Trade Hebben We Nog 3 Andere Pakketten Waar Je Op Termijn Mee In Aanraking Zal Komen

AGP Rent: verhuursoftware, vooral gericht op de horecasector
AGP Project: projectbeheer
AGP Finant: het boekhoudpakket dat door de overige AGP pakketten gebruikt wordt

Je komt terecht in een klein team dat bestaat uit 4 mensen. Dat betekent dat je rol verder gaat dan enkel ontwikkelen. Iedereen helpt elkaar & versterkt elkaar waar nodig.

Jouw Verantwoordelijkheden

Je bent bereid om onze programmeertaal ALI te leren. Dit is een zelfontwikkelde taal met een C++ kernel. Qua structuur zijn er veel gelijkenissen met Cobol. Maar je kan dus enkel terugvallen op jezelf & je collega’s voor hulp!
Je bouwt nieuwe functionaliteiten op basis van stories
Het reviewen van code van je collega’s
Ondersteunen van het supportteam met functionele kennis
Verder ontwikkelen & onderhouden van ons ERP-pakket ‘AGP Trade’
Verder uitwerken van onze REST-api & webtoepassingen
Integraties met 3 e partijen ontwikkelen
Op termijn kijk je ook mee naar de overige AGP pakketten
Kennis opdoen van de overige producten in onze portfolio

Jouw Profiel

Kennis van de database ‘Btrieve’ is een pluspunt
Ervaring met Cobol/Pascal/Delphi
Je duikt graag diep in programmacode om problemen op te lossen
De kernel van onze ontwikkelomgeving is C++. Kennis hierrond is meegenomen, maar niet noodzakelijk
Je beschikt over een bacheloropleiding in de IT en hebt ervaring in softwareontwikkeling.
Kennis van ERP-systemen is een sterk pluspunt
Je bent van nature nieuwsgierig, je leert graag en snel.
Je bent zeer gedreven en vasthoudend.
Je bent een echte teamplayer maar kan ook zelfstandig taken oppakken.

Wat bieden wij?

Een boeiende, uitdagende en zelfstandige job in een dynamisch IT-bedrijf met een directe en open communicatiecultuur en een informele sfeer. Een aangenaam werkklimaat helpt je immers je ambities waar te maken!

Een goed salaris;
Vakantietoeslag 8%;
Een mooie bonusregeling;
26 vakantiedagen (o.b.v. 40 uur) en de mogelijkheid om extra dagen bij te kopen;
Een pensioenregeling voor je oude dag;
WIA Hiaat verzekering;
Laptop;
Reiskosten- of OV vergoeding, we zitten vlakbij het treinstation;
Flexibele werktijden, een goede balans tussen werk- en privé;
Een werkplek op kantoor met gezellige collega’s én de mogelijkheid om deels thuis te werken;
Opleidingen: Volop mogelijkheden om jezelf te ontwikkelen, op de manier die bij jou past.
Extra’s: Vers fruit, soep, fris/ sap, tafelvoetbal, gezellige borrels en ontzettend veel leuke en inspirerende (internationale) collega’s die zomaar vrienden kunnen worden.

Laten we kennismaken!

Klinkt bovenstaand verhaal als muziek in de oren en wil je meer horen? We nodigen je graag uit voor een vrijblijvend gesprek om je nog meer te vertellen over Klipboard en elkaar beter te leren kennen. We horen graag van je!

Gelijke kansen

Klipboard is er trots op een werkplek met gelijke kansen te zijn. We zetten ons in voor gelijke kansen op werk, ongeacht afkomst, huidskleur, religie, geslacht, seksuele geaardheid, leeftijd, burgerlijke staat, handicap of genderidentiteit. Als je een handicap of speciale behoefte hebt, waardoor we het wervingsproces moeten aanpassen, laat het ons dan weten wanneer je contact met ons opneemt.

Bezoek voor meer info onze website op www.klipboard.com

Interesse?

Als jij er van overtuigd bent dat jij de juiste persoon bent voor deze rol ontvangen wij graag je online sollicitatie!

Bezoek voor meer info onze website op www.klipboard.com

Acquisitie wordt niet op prijs gesteld

Aan alle wervingsbureaus: Klipboard accepteert geen ongevraagde cv's van bureaus. Stuur cv's niet door naar onze vacaturesite of rechtstreeks naar een Klipboard -medewerker. Klipboard is niet verantwoordelijk voor eventuele wervingskosten met betrekking tot ongevraagde cv's.

jobs.title: Senior Application Security Engineer
jobs.description:
About Agile Defense

At Agile Defense we know that action defines the outcome and new challenges require new solutions. That’s why we always look to the future and embrace change with an unmovable spirit and the courage to build for what comes next.

Our vision is to bring adaptive innovation to support our nation's most important missions through the seamless integration of advanced technologies, elite minds, and unparalleled agility—leveraging a foundation of speed, flexibility, and ingenuity to strengthen and protect our nation’s vital interests.

Requisition #:
1858

Job Title:
Senior Application Security Engineer

Location:
Remote

Clearance Level:
Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust Clearance

Job Description

Responsible for engineering and optimizing integrated systems that support enterprise-wide digital transformation initiatives. Develops comprehensive solutions that enhance system reliability, scalability, and security. Leads the evaluation of new technologies and system architectures, providing strategic recommendations to enhance organizational capabilities.

Education and Years of Experience

Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or related field, and 4+ years of experience, or equivalent relevant work experience; e.g., each year of work experience may be substituted for each year of education required.

Required Skills

Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust Clearance which requires U.S. citizenship.
1+ year of experience with supporting Static Application Security Testing (SAST), Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST), and IDE Plug-in environments using Veracode .
2+ years of experience with Java, Python, .NET, or C#.
3+ years of experience using the design and implementation of enterprise-wide security controls to secure applications, systems, network, or infrastructure services.
Experience with Eclipse, JDeveloper, including pipeline development, or Visual Studio Experience with securing enterprise web applications and OWASP Top 10, CVSS, CWE, WASC, and SANS-25.
Knowledge of federal compliance standards, including NIST 800-53, FIPS, or FedRAMP.
2+ years experience working in Linux based environments, including navigating and troubleshooting basic website connectivity issues
Familiarity in Linux environment and some type of coding and/or scripting experience is a must.
The areas of focus for this role are Burp Enterprise experience performing DAST scanning.
Experience with Burp Professional, with focus on SAST scanning.
Veracode experience performing SAST scanning.

Preferred Skills

Experience with Interactive Application Security Testing (IAST) capabilities and tools.
Experience with HackerOne.
Experience with Selenium.
Experience writing bash scripts.
Experience with OWASP ZAP or Burp Proxy

$140,000 - $145,000 a year

Our Core Values

Employees of Agile Defense are our number one priority, and the importance we place on our culture here is fundamental. Our culture is alive and evolving, but it always stays true to its roots. Here, you are valued as a family member, and we believe that we can accomplish great things together. Agile Defense has been highly successful in the past few years due to our employees and the culture we create together.

Stel gerust je vraag

Dit ga je doen

Als Azure cloud engineer werk je niet aan één afgebakend stukje, maar aan het platform als geheel – de motor onder de oplossingen die onze workloadteams voor de Rechtspraak bouwen. Dat betekent: schakelen tussen networking, security, compliance, policies en platformstandaarden. Alles wat we doen, leggen we vanaf de basis vast in infrastructure as code met Bicep, Azure Verified Modules en Azure DevOps. Automatisering is daarbij geen extra stap, maar de standaard manier van werken. Je gaat volop de breedte in, zonder technisch aan de oppervlakte te blijven.

Je ziet hoe keuzes op platformniveau doorwerken in de praktijk. Loopt een workloadteam vast bij de inrichting van een Azure-omgeving, dan kom jij in beeld. Bijvoorbeeld als identities niet goed zijn geconfigureerd, netwerkverkeer vastloopt, of een security-policy iets blokkeert terwijl alles op papier klopt. Jij duikt erin: waar zit het probleem, welke instelling staat in de weg, en hoe los je dat zo op dat niet alleen dit team verder kan, maar het hele platform sterker wordt?

Je kijkt verder dan de eerste oplossing. Zie je dat iets slimmer, veiliger of beter schaalbaar kan volgens het CAF? Dan breng je dat in en vertaal je het naar platformverbeteringen die je direct herbruikbaar, beheersbaar en geautomatiseerd vastlegt. Zo bouw je mee aan een platform dat compliant, veilig en schaalbaar is, en waar workloadteams op kunnen vertrouwen.

Wil je meer zijn dan de engineer die alleen uitvoert wat al bedacht is? Houd je van korte lijnen en veel eigen inbreng? En wil je Azure inzetten op een plek waar technische keuzes er echt toe doen? Dan is dit misschien jouw volgende stap.

Dit krijg je

1 jaar
32 - 36 uur

Dit bieden we nog meer

Om te beginnen een leuke, informele werksfeer. We houden de lijnen graag kort! En je arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn prima geregeld volgens de CAO Rijk. Wat belangrijke punten op een rij:

Contract: een jaarcontract voor 32 tot 36 uur per week, met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband.
Salaris: je komt terecht in salarisschaal 10 of 11 (maximaal € 6.275,94 per maand bij een werkweek van 36 uur). Inschaling vindt plaats op basis van je werkervaring.
Keuzebudget: 16,5% van je jaarsalaris (maximaal € 1.035 per maand) om je eigen arbeidsvoorwaarden samen te stellen. Zoals het kopen van verlof, het aanschaffen van een fiets of het verduurzamen van je woning.
Doorgroeimogelijkheden: je functie zit vol mogelijkheden om je kennis verder uit te breiden en je persoonlijke ontwikkeling te stimuleren. En bij onze IVO Academie kun je allerlei trainingen en opleidingen doen.
Werk-privébalans: je bent vrij om je werkdagen flexibel in te delen. Zo kun je deels vanuit huis werken. We dragen € 750 bij aan het inrichten van een comfortabele thuiswerkplek.
Vakanties en vrije dagen: je hebt 144 vakantie- en 64 keuzebudget-uren op basis van een 36-urige werkweek. Dat zijn dus in totaal 26 dagen.
Gratis OV: je krijgt van ons een OV-chipkaart voor je woon-werkverkeer.
Pensioen: je bouwt je pensioen op bij het ABP, een van de grootste pensioenfondsen van Nederland. Ook dat is dus goed geregeld.
Leuke activiteiten: een teamdag, borrelmiddagen, een after summer-feest … er gebeurt van alles. Of organiseer ook zelf iets met je collega’s, van padel tot yoga of een pubquiz.

Meer informatie over onze arbeidsvoorwaarden vind je op www.p-direkt.nl.

Dit vragen wij

Werk- en denkniveau hbo
Ruime ervaring als Azure cloud engineer, platform engineer of in een vergelijkbare rol binnen een complexe IT-omgeving
Ervaring met Azure networking, security, governance en compliance
Plezier in werken met infrastructure as code en ervaring met Bicep, PowerShell, Azure DevOps of vergelijkbare tooling
Begrip van wat nodig is om een betrouwbaar cloudplatform te bouwen en beheren voor meerdere teams, met aandacht voor standaardisatie, automatisering en herbruikbaarheid
Communicatief sterk, gericht op samenwerking met andere teams en in staat om verbeteringen te signaleren én door te voeren

Kom je bij ons werken, dan vragen we ook altijd een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag.

Hier kom je te werken

Over IVO Rechtspraak

Bij IVO Rechtspraak werken rond de 1.000 bevlogen, trotse en betrokken professionals. Samen ontwikkelen en beheren we de digitale systemen voor de rechtspraak. Join us at Hillebrand Gori a company of DHL Global Forwarding

Introduction

Being specialized in alcoholic beverages, we offer a full range of transportation services and options, from full container loads to groupage shipments, from large volumes of bulk wine to small consignments via airfreight. Our logistics services allow our customers to transport exactly what they want, when they want, in a costeffective way.

To support our continued growth and digital transformation, we are expanding our software development
team with a C++/C# developer
. In this role, you will join our software development department of 55+ professionals covering analysis, development, and testing. The team is highly autonomous and works closely with Product Owners to build inhouse, businessdriven applications.

Our architecture is API first, cloudnative, and centered around Microsoft Azure, with Apigee for API management and Okta for identity and access management. We are currently migrating our C++ client server transport management system to this architecture.

You will assist in the C++ development of the current client server application as well as help with the C# rest api backend. At first, the C++ programming will take the majority of your time with a shift towards C# backend development within Azure as the migration project continues on.

To be successful as a developer, you are analytical, technically strong, and comfortable translating business requirements into robust, secure, and scalable software solutions.

Why work at Hillebrand Gori?

With great pride, we can say that Hillebrand Gori is the largest beverages logistics company in the world. Founded in 1844, we are active in over 90 countries. Our success is built on the dedication of our people. While we operate globally with more than 2,200 employees, our IT department is largely located in The Netherlands but also has a presence in Italy, France and India. Within our department around 15 different nationalities work together.

We believe that “Our people and our reputation are our greatest assets.” You will work in an environment where you can make impact, influence strategic technology decisions, and grow both personally and professionally.

Are you looking for a role where you can apply deep expertise and deliver direct business value? Then we’d like to meet you.

What will you do?

As a software engineer, you will:

Develop and maintain the C++ frontend of our transport management application.
Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and integrate thirdparty services which are created design first
Design and implement integrations between internal systems and external partners using messagebased patterns (e.g. publish/subscribe, async messaging)
Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code following best practices and coding standards
Optimize applications for maximum speed and scalability
Implement security and data protection measures
Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to team members
Write and maintain technical documentation

Experience with Agile development methodologies
Solid understanding of OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and modern security patterns
Experience with version control systems (Git)
Good command of the English language (spoken and written)
Currently living in The Netherlands within commuting distance of Haarlem
Knowledge of MFC and ODBC
Knowledge of C++
Knowledge of C#
Good command of the English language (spoken and written)

Currently living in The Netherlands within a normal commute of Haarlem

Preferred Qualifications

Strong knowledge of cloud architecture in Microsoft Azure
Experience with API management, preferably using Apigee
Experience with cloud platforms (Azure)
Experience with CI/CD pipelines
If the above is not available, willingness to transform from C++ to C# API developer.

What can you expect from us?

A salary tailored to your qualities and experience
A contract for 40 hours
Reimbursement for travel expenses, work from home allowance and internet allowance
Pension scheme with BeFrank
Flexible working hours and possibility to work from home
Personal growth and challenging work with endless possibilities to realize your ambitions in an international environment

You can work independently and make us better with your own input
Professional training
a fun place to work, with room for recreation; weekly and monthly drinks, quarterly company meet-ups, regular company festivities

(unlimited, full-time) to join our team located in Tallinn, Berlin or Stockholm

jobs.description:
Über Atos

Atos ist die Marke der Atos Group für KI-gestützte, sichere und ganzheitliche digitale Services. Atos entwirft, entwickelt und betreibt kritische digitale Umgebungen, die Leistungsfähigkeit, Ausfallsicherheit und Souveränität fördern. So unterstützt Atos öffentliche und private Organisationen weltweit dabei, die Kontrolle über ihre Daten und IT-Infrastrukturen zu bewahren und gleichzeitig regulatorische Anforderungen zu erfüllen.

Mit mehr als 54.000 Mitarbeitenden betreut Atos über 4.500 Kunden in 54 Ländern, und unterstützt sie bei der Modernisierung ihrer zentralen IT-Systeme, der Beschleunigung ihrer Cloud- und Datentransformation, der Stärkung ihrer Cybersicherheit sowie der Bereitstellung sicherer digitaler Arbeitsplatzlösungen – zum Nutzen seiner Kunden, ihrer Mitarbeitenden und der Gesellschaft. Darüber hinaus bietet Atos unter der Marke Atos Amplify Beratungsleistungen an.

Als vertrauenswürdiger Partner beim Betrieb komplexer und geschäftskritischer Umgebungen unterstützt Atos Organisationen in stark regulierten und souveränen Kontexten.

Über die Atos Group

Die Atos Group ist ein weltweit führender Anbieter im Bereich der digitalen Transformation. Mit ca. 56.000 Mitarbeitenden und einem Jahresumsatz von ca. 7,2 Mrd. EUR (auf Basis des künftigen Unternehmenszuschnitts) agiert das Unternehmen in 54 Ländern unter zwei Marken Atos für Services und Eviden für Produkte und Systeme. Als europäische Nummer eins in der Cybersicherheit und führend im Bereich Cloud arbeitet die Atos Group für eine sichere und dekarbonisierte Zukunft und bietet maßgeschneiderte KI-gestützte End-to-End Lösungen für alle Branchen. Atos Group ist an der Euronext Paris notiert.

Unser Team

Kommen Sie ins Defense Team Deutschland
Wir sind ein hochspezialisiertes, cross-functional Team, das technologische Lösungen für die innere und äußere Sicherheit Deutschlands
entwickelt .
Bei uns übernehmen Sie echte Verantwortung – sie prägen Architekturentscheidungen, treiben Skalierungsthemen voran und gestalten Lösungen mit direktem Impact für kritische Anwender mit höchsten Anforderungen an Sicherheit, Verfügbarkeit und Skalierbarkeit.

Das sind Ihre Aufgaben

Als Principal C# Developer (m/w/d)
im Bereich Operations Defense & Intelligence (OPS DI) übernehmen Sie die technische Gesamtverantwortung für die Konzeption, Entwicklung und Qualität komplexer Applikationen und Softwarelösungen, die weit über den Funktionsumfang von Standardsoftware hinausgehen.

Sie prägen maßgeblich das technologische Lösungsdesign und wirken sowohl in Angebotsprozessen als auch in Architekturentscheidungen strategisch mit. In Kundenprojekten übernehmen Sie die fachliche Führung von Entwicklungsteams, steuern gesamte Entwicklungsströme und verantworten die Einhaltung technischer Standards, Aufwände und Qualitätsergebnisse.

Durch Ihr tiefgehendes technologisches Know-how und Ihre Fähigkeit, geschäftliche und technische Anforderungen zu verknüpfen, tragen Sie wesentlich zur erfolgreichen Realisierung anspruchsvoller IT‑Projekte und zur Weiterentwicklung des Atos‑Portfolios bei. Zu ihren Aufgaben gehören außerdem

Technische Gesamtverantwortung & Architektur

Verantwortung für das Lösungsdesign im Angebotsprozess, einschließlich Bewertung von Anforderungen sowie Auswahl geeigneter Technologien und Softwarepakete
Analyse, Design und Erstellung komplexer Systemarchitekturen und Softwarelösungsarchitekturen
Verantwortliche Ausarbeitung technischer Konzepte für Anwendungen, Module und Gesamtsysteme

Implementierung & Engineering

Entwicklung anspruchsvoller Applikationskomponenten mit Schwerpunkt C#, .NET Core, modernen UI‑Frameworks und Webtechnologien
Verantwortung für modul- und applikationsübergreifende Implementierungsstrategien
Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Architekturvorgaben, Design‑Patterns, Entwicklungsstandards sowie Security‑ und Compliance‑Anforderungen

Test, Qualitätssicherung & Delivery

Verantwortung für die Planung, Konzeption und Umsetzung technischer Testfälle sowie der erforderlichen Testumgebungen
Erstellung von Qualitäts- und Abnahmekonzepten für die gesamte Lösung
Steuerung der technischen Abnahmeprozesse sowie Sicherstellung der fristgerechten Lieferung in hoher Qualität

Aufwandsschätzung, Projektsteuerung & Delivery-Modelle

Erstellung von Aufwandsschätzungen und Kalkulationsgrundlagen auf Modul-, System- und Gesamtlösungsebene
Präsentation und Verteidigung von Aufwands- und Technologiebewertungen gegenüber Projektleitern und Kunden
Auswahl und Steuerung geeigneter Delivery-Modelle (Nearshore, Offshore, Hybrid)
Eigenverantwortliche (Teil‑)Projektleitung und technische Steuerung von Teams

Kundeninteraktion & Business Development

Durchführung von Kunden-Workshops, Technologiedemonstrationen und Architekturpräsentationen auf Senior‑Level
Aufbau, Pflege und Erweiterung eines nachhaltigen Kunden- und Stakeholdernetzwerks
Proaktive Identifizierung und Bewertung neuer Optimierungs- und Geschäftsmöglichkeiten im Atos‑Portfolio
Unterstützung des Vertriebs bei technischen Angeboten und Pre‑Sales‑Aktivitäten

Innovation, Coaching & Weiterentwicklung

Identifikation, Bewertung und Einführung neuer Methoden, Frameworks, Tools und Entwicklungsverfahren
Wissenstransfer, Coaching und technische Schulungen für interne Teams und Kunden
Aktive Mitwirkung an internen Arbeitskreisen, Best‑Practice‑Entwicklung und Methodikstandards

Für diese Position wird eine umfangreiche technische und methodische Expertise erwartet, wie sie typischerweise durch ein abgeschlossenes Studium (Bachelor oder Master) sowie langjährige Berufserfahrung in Softwareentwicklung und technischem Projektmanagement erworben wurde. Fundierte langjährige Erfahrung in der Entwicklung komplexer, integrierter Softwarelösungen inkl. UML, Domain‑Design, OOP‑Prinzipien und Enterprise‑Patterns

Langjährige Erfahrung in der Erstellung technischer Dokumentationen, Architekturkonzepte und Lösungsdesigns

Fachliche Führungserfahrung von Entwicklungsteams, auch in verteilten Delivery-Modellen
Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit auf Senior‑Stakeholder‑Level
Fähigkeit zur Abstraktion, Modellierung, Vereinfachung und Strukturierung komplexer Sachverhalte

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - AI
jobs.description:
Enterprises are adopting AI faster than they can govern it — and they are looking for a partner who can do two things at once: speak credibly about AI trust, governance, and security, and actually build. The Forward Deployed Engineer (AI) is that partner.
You are the technical face of AvePoint inside client organizations: equally comfortable whiteboarding AI trust and governance concepts with a CISO, translating a business problem into a scoped AI build project, and writing the first working prototype yourself. You embed with clients, ship real outcomes, and own the engagement end to end.
This is not a pre-sales role with a demo script, and not a back-office delivery role. It is the engagement model pioneered by leading AI companies for their strategic enterprise customers: a senior engineer deployed forward, with the autonomy to own the problem from first workshop to production.
What you'll doAdvise on AI trust and governance. Lead workshops that help clients understand and take control of their AI landscape — agents, copilots, models, and the data behind them, including the shadow AI they didn't know about. Explain AI governance, security posture, and resilience concepts credibly to both technical teams and executives. Guide clients through obligations such as the EU AI Act, NIS2, and ISO 42001, and help them stand up practical operating models: AI inventories, approval workflows, risk classification, and audit evidence.
Scope and shape AI build projects. Sit with business stakeholders to understand the underlying need behind "we want AI for X." Identify the highest-value use cases, define success criteria, and translate ambiguous requirements into concrete, estimable technical scopes — architecture outlines, data and integration requirements, delivery phases, effort and risk assessments. Write statements of work that engineering teams can actually deliver and clients can actually sign.
Build and deliver. Develop prototypes and production components for client AI solutions: agent workflows, RAG pipelines, LLM integrations (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex, Anthropic), MCP-based tool integrations, and the governance and security controls around them. Deliver custom adapters and local tooling for regulated, cloud-restricted, or air-gapped environments where standard SaaS approaches cannot go.
Own the relationship through delivery. Act as the trusted technical advisor from first workshop through go-live: run enablement sessions, support adoption, troubleshoot in production, and expand the engagement where you see genuine value for the client.
What we're looking forMust-haves 5+ years in software engineering, solutions architecture, or technical consulting, with at least 2 years hands-on with modern AI/LLM systems in real projects (not only experimentation).
Practical experience building with LLM APIs and frameworks (e.g., Azure OpenAI, Bedrock, Vertex, LangChain, Semantic Kernel) and patterns such as RAG, agentic workflows, and tool/function calling.
Machine Learning Expertise:
Hands-on machine learning experience spanning model development, evaluation, deployment, and operationalization, with a focus on enterprise AI solutions, predictive analytics, and scalable MLOps practices.
Strong programming skills in Python and/or C#/TypeScript, plus working fluency with at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including identity, networking, and data services.
Demonstrated ability to scope technical projects from ambiguous business requirements: you can run a requirements workshop, challenge assumptions constructively, and produce a credible plan with phases, estimates, and risks.
Excellent communication in front of senior stakeholders — you can explain why AI governance matters to a board member and debate vector database trade-offs with a platform engineer in the same meeting.
Willingness to travel to client sites and to operate with high autonomy in ambiguous, fast-moving engagements.

Strong pluses Working knowledge of AI governance and compliance frameworks: EU AI Act, NIS2, ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF, or Gartner's AI TRiSM model.
Experience with AI security topics: prompt injection, data leakage, agent permissioning, model and data security posture (AI-SPM/DSPM concepts).
Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent runtimes, or vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus, Weaviate, Chroma).
Background in enterprise data governance, security, backup/resilience, or the Microsoft 365 / multi-cloud ecosystem where AvePoint operates.
Experience delivering into regulated industries (public sector, defense, financial services, healthcare) or air-gapped/sovereign environments.
Prior experience in a forward-deployed, embedded consulting, or customer-facing engineering role.
Additional languages relevant to your region's client base.

How we'll measure success Within your first 6–12 months, you will have led AI discovery and governance workshops for multiple enterprise clients, scoped and won at least one significant AI build or governance engagement, and delivered working software into a client environment. Above all: clients ask for you by name.
Why this role, why now AI adoption has outrun enterprise control, and regulators have noticed. Every large organization now needs to see, govern, secure, and sustain its AI estate — and most need a partner who can both advise and build. As an FDE at AvePoint you will help define this engagement model from the ground floor, work at the frontier of agentic AI and AI trust, and do it with two decades of enterprise data governance and resilience expertise behind you.

Mehrjährige Senior-Erfahrung im Full-Stack-Engineering moderner Webanwendungen mit tiefem Know-how in mindestens einem Frontend-Stack (React oder Angular) und einem Backend-Stack (Java/Spring Boot oder Python), idealerweise mit End-to-End-Verantwortung im Produktkontext.
Abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium (Master oder Promotion) in Informatik, Software Engineering oder einem vergleichbaren technischen Studiengang mit überdurchschnittlichen Leistungen.
Fundierte Praxis mit unseren Kerntechnologien wie React/Angular, Java Spring Boot, Python, C#, Kafka, Terraform sowie Cloud-/DevOps-Umgebungen (Kubernetes, Helm, ArgoCD); Erfahrung mit LLM-Tools wie Azure OpenAI, Anthropic SDK oder MCP ist ein starkes Plus.
Nachweislich effektiver Einsatz von AI im Software-Engineering, idealerweise inklusive Claude Code oder vergleichbaren agentischen Coding-Tools (Agents, Skills, Workflows) sowie Erfahrung im Design von AI-Pipelines, Harnesses und Context Engineering.
Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und fließendes Englisch in Wort und Schrift, ausgeprägte Problemlösungsstärke, Innovationsfreude, hohe Proaktivität, sehr gute Zusammenarbeit mit Product Management und ein klares Alignment mit unserem Healthcare-Purpose und einem unternehmerischen Mindset.

Das Kannst Du Von Uns Erwarten

Mobile Work: Arbeite flexibel an zwei Tagen pro Woche mobil und an 3 Tagen vor Ort.
Attraktive Standorte: An unseren Standorten erwarten Dich neben voll ausgestatteten Arbeitsplätzen auch regelmäßige Events wie Sommerfeste und Weihnachtsfeiern.
Entwicklung: Unsere Inhouse-Academy und unser Portfolio aus externen Kooperationspartnern unterstützen Dich in Deiner Weiterentwicklung.
Gesundheit: Gesundheit ist für uns ein hohes Gut. In der hauseigenen Kantine gibt es jeden Tag eine Auswahl an leckeren und gesunden Gerichten und in unserem voll ausgestatteten Fitnessstudio heißen wir Dich in wöchentlichen Kursen gerne willkommen.
Mehr geht immer: Der Kindergarten auf unserem CGM-Campus in Koblenz unterstützt unsere Mitarbeitenden dabei, ihren Arbeitsalltag noch flexibler zu gestalten. Wir halten außerdem Corporate Benefits, die Möglichkeit eines Jobrads, BAV u. v. m. für Dich bereit.

Vielfalt ist Teil von CGM!
Wir freuen uns unabhängig von Behinderung, Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität auf Deine Bewerbung.

Bewirb Dich jetzt online mit Deinen aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (inkl. Deiner Zeugnisse, Gehaltsvorstellung und nächstmöglichem Eintrittstermin).

jobs.description:
Company Description

Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.

Internal Grade E/EB9

Job Description

We are looking for an experienced Senior .NET Developer (C#) to join the Acquisitions & Originations engineering team within Experian's Credit & Verification Services business.

The Domain

The Acquisitions & Originations team develops and provides level 3 support for the Delphi Select and Evaluate platforms, which are used across the Acquisitions and Originations business. These are complex, configuration-driven, multi-client systems: each client (bank, lender or other financial institution) runs its own decisioning strategies, rules and data configurations on a shared codebase.

Clients depend on these systems to make real-time lending and origination decisions, so reliability, data integrity and controlled release processes are central to the role.

This is a hybrid, Nottingham based role (40% in the office) reporting to the Lead Developer.

Key Responsibilities

Own features end-to-end across the full software development lifecycle: requirements analysis, technical design, development, unit and integration testing, code review, deployment and post-release support.
Design, develop and maintain scalable, maintainable C#/.NET services and components within a complex, multi-client system, ensuring changes are safe across all client configurations.
Translate high-level and client-specific requirements into robust technical designs, in collaboration with the Technical Lead, Architects, Business Analysts and Product Owners.
Maintain and improve automated test coverage (unit, integration and regression) to support safe, frequent releases into a live multi-client platform.
Contribute to and help evolve CI/CD pipelines (Git, Jenkins)
Identify and help remediate technical debt, and contribute to ongoing modernisation of the platform, including its migration towards cloud-native (AWS) architecture.
Mentor Intermediate and Junior developers, sharing technical knowledge and supporting their growth, including in the effective use of AI-assisted development tools.

Qualifications

Required Skills / Knowledge

Strong expertise in .NET Core / .NET Framework and C#, including object-oriented design and common design patterns.
Proven experience across the full software development lifecycle, ideally supporting a live, business-critical production system.
Solid experience with SQL Server / T-SQL, including writing and optimising queries and stored procedures against production data.
Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs, and working with service-oriented or microservice architectures.
Practical experience with unit and integration testing frameworks (e.g. xUnit, NUnit or MSTest).
Experience with version control and CI/CD tooling (e.g. Git, Jenkins, or equivalent).
Direct experience working in a Scrum or other Agile team, including sprint planning, stand-ups and retrospectives.
Hands-on, everyday experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT) for tasks such as code generation, refactoring, test writing, debugging and documentation

Useful Skills (beneficial, Not Mandatory)

Exposure to AWS services (e.g. DynamoDB, S3, EC2 ) or a strong interest in developing cloud skills as the platform migrates to AWS.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (e.g. Terraform, CloudFormation).
Knowledge of containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes).
Experience in financial services, lending, credit decisioning or a similarly regulated domain.
Exposure to front-end technologies such as React or modern JavaScript/TypeScript.
Experience working with configuration-driven or rules-engine-based systems.

Additional Information

Benefits include:-

Great compensation package and discretionary bonus plan
Core benefits include pension, bupa healthcare, sharesave scheme and more!
25 days annual leave with 8 bank holidays and 3 volunteering days. You can also purchase additional annual leave.

Experian will never ask candidates to make any payment as part of an application, interview, assessment, onboarding, or recruitment process. To apply for roles or verify opportunities, please visit experian.com/careers.

Experian's people first, inclusive and purpose driven culture is multi award-winning; World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Fortune Global Top 25), Great Place To Work™ in 26 countries to name a few. Today, Jumbo operates across Australia, the UK, Canada and the US, bringing together technology, creativity and purpose to create premium digital experiences people love.

Based in Galgate, StarVale is dedicated to strengthening the fundraising power of charities, not‑for‑profits, and hospices across the UK. We combine specialist lottery management with a genuine commitment to helping organisations maximise their impact, so more communities receive the support they deserve.

What will you be doing?

We’re looking for a .NET Web Developer to join us in this hands‑on build‑and‑migrate role. You will be rewriting existing PHP websites in .NET, integrating them with our business systems, and helping shape how we structure our shared architecture going forward. Working closely with cross‑functional teams, you will support day‑to‑day business needs, solve complex technical challenges, and contribute to high‑quality engineering practices through code reviews, documentation, and collaborative solution design.

What Your Day-to-Day Will Look Like

Your daily work will centre on maintaining, modernising, and progressively transforming our legacy .NET systems while supporting the smooth running of core business operations across StarVale. You can expect to:

Design and build ASP.NET Core websites targeting modern .NET versions (including .NET 10)
Migrate Laravel and CodeIgniter sites to the .NET platform while preserving functionality, SEO, and data integrity
Work with Umbraco CMS — extending existing implementations or building new sites where appropriate
Integrate websites with core .NET business systems and SQL Server databases
Write and maintain EF Core data access code, including migrating data from MySQL to SQL Server
Document business logic and edge cases from existing PHP sites before decommissioning
Contribute to shared architecture decisions, internal libraries, and coding standards
Write clean, tested, maintainable code and participate in code reviews

What You’ll Be Able to Bring to the Role

Essential

Solid commercial experience with C# and ASP.NET Core (or strong ASP.NET MVC experience with a clear path to Core)
Experience with Entity Framework Core (or EF) and relational databases (SQL Server)
Comfortable working with front-end fundamentals (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) alongside server-rendered .NET views or Razor Pages
Experience migrating or integrating systems between different platforms or frameworks
Ability to read and understand PHP (Laravel and/or CodeIgniter) well enough to translate existing functionality into .NET — you won't be writing new PHP, but you'll need to understand what's there
Good understanding of web fundamentals: routing, authentication, forms, SEO basics (URL structure, redirects)

Migration Mindset: Confidence to evaluate legacy code, challenge outdated practices, and guide non-technical stakeholders through modernized technical solutions.
Problem Solver: Highly resourceful with strong initiative, able to own projects independently from requirements-gathering to deployment.
Communication: Excellent people skills to liaise effectively between technical teams, external auditors, and cross-departmental stakeholders.

Preferred

Experience with Umbraco CMS
Experience with Blazor
Familiarity with Azure or other cloud hosting for .NET applications
Experience leading or contributing to a platform migration or legacy system modernization
Understanding of REST API design, for connecting websites to internal business systems
Ability to work within agile environments, including Kanban and Sprints.

Salary Banding: £35,000–£45,000 per annum, depending on experience.

Our Ways of Working

At StarVale, we value balance and flexibility. You will be based in our office in Galgate, Lancaster. This role is a flexible hybrid, typically averaging 50% in the office (2-3 days per week). We prioritise results and collaborate to make sure everyone can contribute effectively, while enjoying flexibility and balance in how they work.

Find Your Freedom - https://bit.ly/Jumbointeractive

Produce and maintain technical documentation to the required standards.

Technical design and software development.
