jobs.description:
Description

About Xe

Xe is a cross-border payments platform. We help SMEs and consumers in the US, UK, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand collect, convert, hold, and send money across markets. Each year, over 300 million people use Xe for currency information and over 350,000 use us to send money overseas.

Today, we're rebuilding the platform layer behind cross-border payments for corporate and consumer clients. We're small enough that your code ships fast and your decisions matter, and Euronet Worldwide (Nasdaq: EEFT) backs us so the problems stay real-scale.

About This Role

We're hiring a senior back-end engineer who owns real problems end-to-end and shapes how the team builds, from API design and data modeling through to service implementation, production reliability, and launch. You already use AI as part of how you think, build, test, and ship.

You'll write code that moves money in production, design and modernize the backend services the platform runs on, and lead delivery of new capability as Xe rebuilds its platform layer. You'll work in a small team with direct access to product, compliance, and operations, own architecture in your domain, lead design reviews, mentor mid-level engineers, and partner with architects and team leads on cross-domain decisions.

What You'll Do

Design and own backend services that move money and manage multi-currency balances across a range of domains, including onboarding, KYC and KYB, payment initiation, FX, settlement, and other supporting services.
Lead cross-functional delivery with product, compliance, and operations from problem framing through launch.
Lead the build of the partner integrations and settlement infrastructure your domain depends on.
Own production health for your domain, including reliability, observability, on-call, and incident response.
Lead design reviews, set technical direction for your domain, and mentor mid-level engineers.
Use agentic coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent) daily across the SDLC, and lead modernization from legacy services into the modern stack alongside architects and team leads in your domain.

What We're Looking For

Must-have

6 to 10+ years building production backend services, end-to-end.
Strong backend proficiency in C# / .NET preferred; other OOP languages welcome (Java, Kotlin, Go, or equivalent).
SQL and relational database fundamentals.
Writing and maintaining tests.
Daily use of agentic coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent) across the SDLC.
Production experience with AWS, including hands-on deployment, CI/CD pipelines and modern deployment practices, and native services such as SQS, DynamoDB, S3, ECS, and Lambda.
Strong system design and architecture experience, including service-oriented or microservices and event-driven patterns.
Payments, FX, or regulated-industry experience.
Track record of technical leadership: mentoring engineers, leading design reviews, and making architecture decisions in your domain.
Strong written and verbal communication.

Nice-to-have

Experience with ledgers, double-entry accounting, or other financial-data systems.
Experience hiring, interviewing, or onboarding engineers.
Experience leading modernization or platform migrations.
Experience with caching solutions like Memcached or Redis.
Experience using project management and documentation tools like Jira and Confluence.
Knowledge of API testing tools such as Postman or Bruno.
Writing automated tests alongside development with AI tools (Claude Code or equivalent).

Perks & Benefits

Competitive Salary & Discretionary Bonus
23 days annual leave increasing with service (capped at 28 days)
Paid day off for your Birthday
4% employer pension contribution
Discounted Euronet ESPP
Life Cover, Income Protection & Critical Illness cover
Healthcare
Plumm Mental Health and Wellbeing
Volunteering day for a charity of your choice

We want Xe to be a great place to work and to ensure that our communities are represented across our workforce. A vital part of this is ensuring we are a truly inclusive organization that encourages diversity in all respects.

Xe is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment regardless of age, national origin, race, color, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at recruitment@xe.com.

Software engineering: commercial experience as a developer, ideally C#/.NET

Job Requisition ID #

26WD100960

Autodesk is looking for a Software Development Engineer in Test with an interest in CI/CD and release engineering to help build the automated quality and software delivery systems for a new Electron-based desktop platform. In this hands-on individual contributor role, you will develop and maintain test automation, CI/CD pipelines, desktop packaging, and release validation. You will work with experienced engineers to improve developer feedback, automate repeatable release processes, troubleshoot technical issues, and help ensure that customer releases are reliable and well tested. This is a hybrid role based in our Sheffield office.

Responsibilities

Test automation - approximately 35%: Develop and maintain automated functional, integration, end-to-end, installer, upgrade, and regression tests. Add automated coverage for new features and improve existing tests as the product evolves
CI/CD and build automation - approximately 30%: Develop and maintain continuous integration pipelines using Jenkins or similar systems. Automate build, test, packaging, artifact creation, and related engineering workflows
Release qualification and automation - approximately 20%: Help automate Windows desktop packaging, code signing, publishing, installation validation, upgrade testing, and release-candidate qualification
Troubleshooting and quality improvement - approximately 15%: Investigate build, test, installer, and application failures. Work with software engineers to identify root causes, reproduce issues, and implement or automate solutions
Review product requirements and user stories to understand test scope, identify quality risks, and contribute to test plans
Execute functional, integration, regression, and other forms of testing when automation is not yet available or when exploratory validation is appropriate.
Build and maintain reusable test utilities, test data, and automation components
Help create automated Windows test environments using virtual machines or other reproducible infrastructure
Participate in release-readiness activities, bug bashes, defect triage, and risk assessment
Monitor test and pipeline results, report failures clearly, and help distinguish product defects from test or infrastructure issues
Improve flaky tests and unreliable pipeline stages to increase the quality of developer feedback
Document build, test, and release procedures so they can be understood and maintained by the broader engineering team
Collaborate with software engineers, product teams, and infrastructure teams to improve product quality and engineering productivity

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
Software development or test automation experience using a language such as Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, PowerShell, C#, Java, or similar
Experience developing automated tests for software applications
Familiarity with continuous integration and delivery concepts and tools such as Jenkins, CloudBees CI, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar
Understanding of source control systems such as Git and common software development workflows
Ability to troubleshoot common software, test automation, build, and environment problems
Understanding of software testing practices including functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing
Ability to work collaboratively with software engineers and other technical team members
Strong written and verbal communication skills

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Windows desktop applications
Experience with Electron or applications built using web technologies
Experience with Windows packaging technologies such as MSI, WiX, NSIS, or similar
Experience working with Jenkins or CloudBees CI pipelines
Familiarity with Windows code signing and software publishing workflows
Experience automating install, upgrade, uninstall, and application-startup scenarios
Experience using virtual machines or other automated test environments
Familiarity with enterprise Windows environments, device-management systems, corporate proxies, or restricted-user configurations
Experience investigating intermittent or flaky automated tests

The Ideal Candidate

You enjoy writing code that makes software development and testing more reliable. You are interested in understanding how software moves from a developer's change to a tested customer release, and you like working across test automation, build systems, and desktop application behavior.

You are comfortable troubleshooting technical problems, learning unfamiliar tools, asking questions when needed, and working with more experienced engineers on complex issues. You look for opportunities to automate repetitive work and improve the reliability of the team's development and release processes.

You also value the benefits of hybrid collaboration and are comfortable working regularly from Autodesk's Sheffield office while partnering with distributed teams across the company.

We are building a new desktop platform that enables Autodesk's web-based products to deliver richer, higher-performance experiences on Windows. Forma is the first product adopting the platform, with the longer-term goal of creating reusable desktop capabilities for additional Autodesk products.

You will join a new cross-functional platform team working across desktop application engineering, test automation, continuous integration and delivery, and software release.

Engineer - IT Manufacturing Execution

As an Engineer at Elanco, you will be a key technical contributor to the digital heart of our production facilities. You will specialize in implementing and supporting our Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES). This hands-on role is the critical bridge between our physical manufacturing processes and the digital systems that control and document them, ensuring our operations are efficient, compliant, and reliable.

This includes four strategic priorities:

Pipeline Acceleration: Optimize the search and approval of high impact medicines with a focus on speed, cost and precision.
Manufacturing Excellence: Improve the efficiency, quality and consistency of core manufacturing processes, specifically execution and equipment effectiveness.
Sales Effectiveness: Simplify the process to find, trust and consume relevant customer insights that drive sales growth and improved engagement.
Productivity: Expand operating margin through efficiency by systematically reducing our operating expenses across the company, improving profitability.

Your Responsibilities:

System Design and Configuration: Contribute to the design and be responsible for the configuration and implementation of MES solutions. This includes building and modifying electronic batch records (EBRs), system workflows, and configuring equipment integration based on defined requirements.
Process Optimization: Collaborate with operations and quality teams to analyze manufacturing and laboratory workflows. You will use MES capabilities to help implement process improvements, reduce production cycle times, and enhance data integrity at the shop-floor level.
System Management and Support: Provide frontline technical support for MES platforms. You will act as a key technical resource to troubleshoot and resolve system issues, ensuring high availability for our manufacturing and lab teams.
Integration: Assist with the integration between MES and other critical systems, such as our ERP (SAP), and shop-floor equipment (PLCs/SCADA), ensuring a reliable flow of data.
Validation and Compliance: Execute validation protocols (IQ/OQ/PQ) for MES enhancements and new implementations. You will be responsible for generating validation documentation and ensuring systems are maintained in a validated state, compliant with GxP and data integrity requirements.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with Manufacturing Operations, Quality Assurance, and Process Science teams to gather system requirements and provide updates on technical activities.
User Training and Enablement: Develop training materials and conduct training sessions to ensure that manufacturing and lab personnel are proficient in using the MES/LES systems effectively in their day-to-day roles.

Educational Background: A Bachelor's degree in Engineering (e.g., Industrial, Chemical, Manufacturing, Computer Science) or a related technical field or equivalent experience.
Required Experience: 3+ years hands-on experience with the configuration, and support of an MES platform (e.g., Tulip, Werum PAS-X, Emerson Syncade, POMSnet).
Manufacturing Environment Experience: Experience working directly in a manufacturing environment, preferably within the pharmaceutical, biologics, animal health, or another GxP-regulated industry.
Regulatory Knowledge: A working knowledge of GxP (Good Manufacturing Practices) and familiarity with computer system validation (CSV) principles.
Process Control Understanding: Familiarity with industrial automation concepts, including PLCs, SCADA, and how they integrate with higher-level manufacturing systems.
Database and SQL Skills: Experience with SQL for data queries to support troubleshooting, data extraction, and report generation.

What Will Give You the Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications):

Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to systematically diagnose and resolve technical issues.
Process Analysis: A solid understanding of business process analysis and workflow design. Ability to read and interpret process maps and requirements documents.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Good communication and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to work effectively in a team environment with operators, scientists, and management.
Cloud Platform Proficiency: Familiarity with Public Cloud platforms, specifically Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform (GCP), is a plus.
DevSecOps: Familiarity with the concepts of DevSecOps, including Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) and source control (Git), is desirable.
Communication Skills: Good verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively within a technical team.

Location: Hook, UK - Hybrid Work Environment or Speke, UK – Hybrid Work Environment

2+ years of professional software development experience.

English proficiency. Strong verbal and written communication skills.

Experience with version control (Git).

Good communication and collaboration skills, with proficiency in English.

We are looking for a

Senior Backend Engineer (C#/.Net) (m/f/d)

Join our team at our location in Stockholm – hybrid working conditions available.

Our solutions contribute to flexible and customer-friendly payment alternatives. We offer consumers the opportunity to choose when and how they want to pay, whilst guaranteeing a steady and predictable cashflow for merchants. Our products make us proud, but not content and we have high ambitions for our existing as well as upcoming products. We have a strong commitment to building the future of FinTech — human-centric and sustainable. With investments to back it up. You will be part of a new and quickly growing product & tech organisation, having the opportunity to shape our new teams as well as build the next revolutionary products.

Build & scale core services: Design, build, and ship robust backend services, APIs, and business-critical workflows using modern C# and .NET.
Shape system architecture: Drive decisions on scalability, resilience, and performance for high-throughput distributed systems.
Turn requirements into reality: Partner with product managers, designers, and domain experts to translate complex business needs into pragmatic technical solutions.
Elevate the team: Mentor colleagues, conduct thoughtful code reviews, and share knowledge to help the engineering group grow.

Backend depth: 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with deep expertise in C# and modern .NET.

Clear communication: Fluent in English, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs to both engineering peers and non-technical partners.

We are looking for an experienced developer who wants to take the next step and combine advanced development with a people-focused leadership role as a Group Manager.

Our development organization consists of approximately 160 highly engaged colleagues who build software used daily in cancer clinics around the globe. As we continue to grow, we are looking for additional group managers who want to help shape our technology, our teams, and our future.

About The Role

This role offers the best of both worlds, combining hands-on technical work with people leadership. You will have personnel responsibility for a team of 8–12 developers while remaining an active contributor to the development of RayStation, our Treatment Planning System.

As a Group Manager, you focus on enabling your team to succeed. You support and develop your employees through regular one-on-one conversations, competence development, and recruitment. You will not be alone in your leadership role, but part of a collaborative management context with support from both peers and the wider organization.

In your role as a developer, you work close to the domain on technically demanding solutions and contribute to building robust, scalable systems. Depending on your background, you will work across backend, frontend, or full-stack development, contributing to architecture and system design. Our solutions are built using modern architectural principles such as Domain-Driven Design, event-driven systems, and asynchronous communication, in an environment where security, data integrity, and reliable system communication are critical. Your technical expertise will have a direct and meaningful impact on patient care.

Your profile

You have a strong technical foundation in .NET development and a clear interest in taking responsibility for both people and technical delivery. You are motivated by building high-performing teams, creating structure, and contributing to a safe and sustainable working environment. With a humble and communicative leadership style, you build trust and take ownership of people-related topics such as performance conversations, competence development, and recruitment, with support from the organization. You are self-driven, proactive, and results-oriented, with the ability to combine deep technical understanding with a present and engaged leadership approach.

To Succeed In This Role, You Bring

A Master’s degree in Engineering or an equivalent academic background
At least 7 years of experience developing complex products using .NET
A genuine interest in people leadership and personnel responsibility
Experience from leadership roles or informal leadership in development teams
A strong drive to contribute to and further develop the engineering organization
Fluency in English, written and spoken.

Previous experience in a role with formal people management responsibility together with fluency in Swedish is not required but considered as highly meritorious.

Our Culture

Culture at RaySeach is the driving force behind our organization, where everything we do is driven by a shared passion for innovation and the fight against cancer. Our dedication is reflected in our ability to deliver exceptional results, pay close attention to detail, and consistently go the extra mile. Our employees stand out as experts in their field, driven by a relentless focus on solving problems - no matter how complex. At RaySearch, we take pride in leading the way in cancer treatment, leveraging cutting-edge technology to develop innovative solutions that make a real difference in patient care.

Our Offer

At RaySearch, we offer a diverse and inclusive work environment, fostering openness, sincerity, and collaboration. Located in Hagastaden, Stockholm's Life Science Hub, our modern and creative workspace includes an in-house gym, yoga, and social activities like ping pong, table football, and regular after-work events. Our bistro serves a fantastic lunch buffet, and we offer morning- and afternoon-fika every day. Our rooftop terrace also provides a stunning 360-degree view of Stockholm, enhancing the work experience. All of this comes attached with a competitive compensation and benefits package.

jobs.title: Support & Testing Engineer
jobs.description:
At Airpelago, we are pioneering the inspection of power grids with drones. We combine modern drone technology, proprietary software, and expertise in drone regulations to help grid owners inspect and get insights about their assets, which our society is dependent on. As we continue to scale, we are looking for a Support & Testing Engineer to be the link between our users in the field and the engineers building the software.

Your mission

Your main focus will be making sure our users succeed with our software - understanding their problems, solving them, and translating recurring issues into concrete input for engineering. You will also spend time in the field, running large-scale tests of our drone automation software to ensure that new software features, drone platforms, or payloads actually work in the real world before release.

Responsibilities

Support our users - pilots, operators and grid owners - with our software, from first question to resolution.
Help onboard new users and customers on our system.
Feed structured insights from the field back into product and engineering priorities.
Plan and execute large-scale field testing of our drone automation software.
Document, reproduce and prioritize bugs, with enough technical detail that engineers can act on them.
Build and maintain test procedures, checklists and reporting so results are comparable over time.
Maintain support documentation, guides and internal knowledge.
Make smaller fixes, scripts and tooling yourself, using AI-assisted development tools where helpful.

What We're Looking For

Experience in a technical and customer-facing support role.
Post-secondary education in a relevant field.
A genuine service mindset - you take full ownership of the user's problem until it is solved.
Tech-savvy and hands-on - you enjoy digging into logs, configurations, and data to find root causes, and you're comfortable making smaller code changes or using AI tools to solve problems.
Structured and methodical mindset, especially when testing at scale.
A valid B driver’s license, with comfort working outdoors and travelling for field testing.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in Swedish and English, with the ability to explain technical things clearly to non-technical users.

As we work with grid owners across Europe, additional languages (especially French, German, or Spanish) are a big plus. Experience with drones, a pilot certificate, or a background in field service/QA will make us even happier. However, your attitude, curiosity, and problem-solving ability are what matter most to us!

Why join Airpelago?

You will play a central role in transforming an industry with automated aerial data. We are currently on an exciting growth journey, and you will become part of a driven, passionate, and highly skilled team. We believe in achieving great things while having fun along the way - including an annual winter office abroad and recurring company gatherings. We offer a dynamic, high-trust environment where our technical innovations directly impact real-world operations and commercial success.

Identify automation opportunities.

th

Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills.

jobs.title: Sr. Analyst / Manager - Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.

Overview

The GBS Capability Optimisation and Automation (GCOA)
organisation is a strategic function focused on transforming finance operations through intelligent automation and AI. GCOA acts as a centralised capability hub, enabling scalable, secure, and compliant solutions that deliver measurable business value.  

GCOA partners with finance and technology teams to:   

Identify automation opportunities.  
Design innovative solutions.  
Embed automation as a core enabler of operational excellence and digital transformation.  

Position Description

The Automation engineer role (P1-P3) will design and build end-to-end automation solutions for Lilly’s global Finance organization working across our full stack platform. The solutions will primarily be built on a platform consisting of a next.js React frontend with Python and PostgresSQL backend hosted on AWS that will interact with Lilly’s AI Platform (NLM and OCR use cases), Microsoft Fabric (PySpark, Delta Lake), SAP API, Graph API and additional systems APIs where necessary.

The primary objective of the team is to develop and deliver automation solutions and other emerging technology solutions for the Finance organization globally. 

Responsibilities

Partner with analyst team to review business opportunities and assessing solution feasibility. 
Participate in various types of interviews, meetings or workshops to define, design and configure solutions. 
Use technology to solve problems concerned with business strategy, organisation, procedures & performance and present findings. 
Analyses and interprets information gained and makes recommendations to business partners and analyst team.
Develop solutions in accordance with team standards and best practices. 
Create architecture and design documents as part of development process. 
Create and document test procedures and scenarios prior to launching User Acceptance Testing (UAT). 
Conduct validations with team and business during the development of the project. 
Support business teams in testing activities, including integration testing, end-to-end (business process) testing and UAT. 
Support BAU team when necessary to problem-solve issues that arise in day-to-day running of automation processes.
Participate in the problem identification/error resolution process, including tracking, repairing and reporting defects. 
Communicate any identified and potential risks and issues to leadership team accordingly and provide actionable inputs to mitigate.
Support QA, audit activities and platform migration activities as needed. 

Experience

5+ Years of programming experience with systems and applications of varying scope and complexity. Preferably finance and supply chain business processes.
Experience with the following technologies: Python, PySpark, TypeScript JS, PostGresSQL.
Bachelor’s degree in Business/Management Information Systems or Computer Science or similar related field.
Ability to work independently, or in groups, sometimes as lead technical participant. 
Ability to take on complex assignments and assume increasingly greater responsibilities. 

Additional Preferences

Experience with Microservices architecture for modular and independently deployable components.
Experience with Docker and Kubernetes for containerization and orchestration, to enable streamlined deployment and scaling processes.
Experience with building system interactions through APIs, SAP being most preferable.
Experience with SAP, MS Fabric (PySpark notebooks, Delta Lake/OneLake), PowerBI, SharePoint Online. 
Exposure to GenAI platforms (OpenAI, Anthropic etc).
Experience in analysing, debugging, and refactoring legacy code.
Exposed to applying statistical concepts and data-quality/anomaly-detection techniques (e.g outlier or threshold-based checks) to business data.

Behavioural Skills

Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills.
An understanding of workflow-based logic; ability to both understand a business process from a workflow diagram or procedural documentation. 
Ability to prioritize, schedule and complete development and testing required for multiple applications with overlapping schedules. 
Experienced in supporting/training more junior team members.
Strong verbal and written communications skills. 
Comfortable working in a busy and dynamic environment with competing priorities.

jobs.title: Value Architect, Industry 4.0
jobs.description:
A senior industrial data and IT/OT expert who turns operational data into results, advising our key clients from strategy through delivery.

Do you enjoy working with industrial data and AI, where OT meets IT and data becomes operational results? Are you equally at home advising senior client stakeholders with a strategic vision and roadmap and, as lead architect, staying hands-on through the work that delivers it? If your answer is yes, then we are looking for you, Value Architect, to join our growing Data & AI Studio.

At Nortal, we build solutions and services that bring real value to users and society as a whole. In Finland, we have nearly 200 employees, and internationally we operate in over 20 countries. Our Data & AI Studio brings together strategy, engineering, and AI to help industrial enterprises turn operational data into results, bridging OT and IT from the shop floor to the cloud, and moving from discovery to scalable, production-grade solutions.

As a Value Architect, Industry 4.0 in our Data & AI Studio, you are a senior subject-matter expert and the trusted advisor industrial clients lean on to turn operational data into results. This is primarily a client-facing role. You work with senior stakeholders on where unified industrial data and AI turn cost into advantage, which investments return the most in uptime, quality, and decision speed, and which team should deliver them. You own the architecture across the IT and OT boundary and stay hands-on through delivery. A smaller part of the role helps the practice grow: you support presales when your expertise is needed, feed what you learn back into our industrial offering, and now and then share it through talks and writing. One morning you frame the business case with a VP of operations. That afternoon you review an edge-to-cloud architecture with the engineers who will build it.

The offering you will work with

Our work in this space turns industrial data into operational results. Most industrial enterprises want to scale AI but cannot, because fragmented OT and IT systems and inconsistent data quality leave them without a foundation to build on. We fix that first.

You take the lead on engagements like our Industrial Data & AI Kickstart and the platform and use-case work that grows out of it. You own them as the lead architect: facilitating the workshops, conducting a significant share of the analysis and design yourself, and bringing in specific experts, from IT/OT and cloud to integration and data and AI, where deeper specialism is needed.
This is operations-first work. It runs from the shop floor to the cloud, bridges OT and IT, and is grounded in real operational needs rather than slideware. You start here, sharpen the offering as you run it, and help shape what comes next.

What You Will Do

This is primarily a client-facing role.

Advise clients and protect the value
Be the trusted advisor.
Work with senior client stakeholders (heads of operations and manufacturing, plant and maintenance leaders, CDOs and CIOs) to connect their priorities to data and AI outcomes, and shape strategies and roadmaps they can act on.
Run the Kickstart.
Lead the discovery and design workshops, assess the as-is OT and IT landscape, and produce the edge-to-cloud target architecture, the governance and operating model, and the roadmap the client executes against.
Own the architecture.
Steer architecture and design decisions across the IT and OT boundary so solutions scale and stay governed, secure, and compliant. You need not ship every integration yourself, but you stand behind the design.
Stay through delivery.
Don’t hand off after the Kickstart. Stay hands-on through platform foundation and use-case pilots to protect the architecture, data governance, quality, and the value case into production.

Contribute to the offering and the practice
A smaller part of the role looks inward. You support presales when your expertise is needed, handle the hard technical objections, and help shape proposals and value cases. You turn what you learn on engagements into reusable patterns and proof points, and you share some of it through talks and writing. You mentor others and help run AI-aware delivery teams, so the practice grows beyond any one person.

What We Hope You Bring

A senior background in manufacturing operations management and industrial data with business acumen
(IT/OT or IIoT Architect, Industrial Data Architect, MES/MOM Lead, or similar), with ten or more years on the consulting or customer side.
Domain depth.
Working knowledge of more than one industry or industry type we serve is required, so you can speak the customer’s language from day one. Experience in both process and discrete industries, such as metals, forest, energy, packaging, chemical, or machine building, is especially welcome.
A track record of growing trusted client relationships
and turning advice into delivered work, with real ownership of the outcome rather than the handover.
Consultative mindset
. You lead with the customer’s operational problem, not with technology. You listen, frame the real question, and guide senior stakeholders to a decision they own. Enterprise architecture skills and experience are a strong asset here, connecting business strategy, operating model, data, and technology into one coherent picture.
Industrial platform familiarity
. Comfortable across the industrial stack, from shop floor to cloud: IT/OT integration, MES/MOM, process historians, edge and connectivity tooling, OPC UA and UNS architectures, data analytics over time-series data, and standards such as ISA-95/88. You are familiar with OT infrastructure, networking, and security, and with architecting containerized workloads at the edge. On the cloud side, you are comfortable with modern data stacks such as Azure IoT, Microsoft Fabric, and Databricks. Relevant certifications are a plus.
Applied AI.
Experience with machine learning solutions deployed in production (beyond PoC scope) for areas such as production, maintenance, quality, and warehouse optimization. GenAI solutions in production are a plus.
Communication.
Strong spoken, written, and presentation skills in Finnish and English, with the ability to reach shop floor engineers, enterprise architects, and operations leaders. German is an asset.
AI-first ways of working.
Comfortable using modern AI tools in your own work, with coding agents a plus. You work AI-first by habit, not by exception.

Why join us

Work where data meets the shop floor.
Real plants and real operations, from the Kickstart through to production, not perpetual pilots. You see the architecture you stand behind actually run.
A community, not a silo.
A multidisciplinary network behind you, from IT/OT, cloud, and integration architects to data and AI specialists, and delivery teams who can actually ship what you design.
Sell from strength.
Twenty-five years of industrial delivery, with experience in industrial digitalization dating back to 1987 and long-standing work with metals, energy, and forest clients. We are a Featured Microsoft Fabric Partner and one of the very few partners named in Microsoft’s Industrial AI Partner Guide.

Salary range:
5900-8800€ / month (full-time). Final compensation will depend on factors such as relevant experience, role seniority, and skill set.

Please note that we will begin reviewing applications in week 31.

Nortal values equality and diversity in our work community. We welcome applicants with different backgrounds, such as in regard to age, gender, culture or minority group.

jobs.title: Cloud Developer - CID
jobs.description:
Experienced Cloud Developer

Brænder du for cloud-arkitektur, integrationer og moderne udviklingsprincipper – og motiveres du af at bygge robuste, skalerbare løsninger tæt på forretningen?

Så har vi en spændende mulighed i Kvik A/S, hvor du bliver en central, spiller i vores Cloud Integration & Development (CID) team.

Måske arbejder du i dag som udvikler og er klar til at tage næste skridt i din karriere?

Som Cloud Developer i Kvik A/S, tilbyder vi netop denne mulighed.

Om teamet (CID)

CID-teamet driver en moderne Microsoft cloud platform i Kvik og er med til at sikre stabile og løbende forbedrede digitale services til vores butikker og interne teams.

Vi arbejder i krydsfeltet mellem forretning og teknologi og bygger integrationer og API-services, der binder vores forretningssystemer sammen.

Vi arbejder tæt sammen med bl.a. BizApps (Power Platform/Dynamics 365), ERP (D365 Business Central), Data (MS DWH/Fabric) og Digital Marketing – og vi lægger vægt på kvalitet, samarbejde og en kultur med højt til loftet.

Det er derfor vigtigt at du ikke kun bringer stærke tekniske kompetencer ind i rollen, men også meget gerne en solid forretningsforståelse, og helt sikkert en vilje til at lære.

Om stillingen

Som Cloud Developer får du et bredt ansvar, hvor du både sætter teknisk retning, skaber overblik og omsætter arkitektur til virkelighed. Du bliver en nøgleperson i arbejdet med at udvikle og vedligeholde vores cloud‑principper, patterns- og standarder – og du hjælper teams og stakeholders med at træffe de rigtige tekniske valg.

Samtidig er du hands-on udvikler og deltager aktivt i design og implementering af C#/.NET baserede løsninger i Azure, herunder API’er, integrations-flows og eventdrevne komponenter baseret på messaging og asynkrone mønstre.

Du arbejder især med de forretningskritiske og komplekse dele af platformen, hvor robusthed, skalerbarhed og driftssikkerhed er afgørende.

Dine primære ansvarsområder

Cloud‑strategi og arkitektur: Udvikle og vedligeholde skalerbare cloud‑arkitekturprincipper og standarder (primært Microsoft-teknologi).
Thought leadership: Være et fagligt fyrtårn og bidrage til retning, kompetencesikring og best practices i CID’s virke.
Governance & compliance: Sikre overholdelse af sikkerhed, lovgivning og interne retningslinjer i cloud‑miljøer.
Innovation og optimering: Identificere nye teknologier og metoder, der skaber forretningsværdi og reducerer omkostninger.
Samarbejde og rådgivning: Arbejde tæt sammen med udviklingsteams, arkitekter og stakeholders for at sikre helhedsorienterede løsninger – og proaktivt drive integrations‑ (og evt. AI-) initiativer.
Automatisering og drift: Drive automatisering, DevOps-principper og Infrastructure as Code.
CI/CD og platform: Vedligeholde og videreudvikle CI/CD-processer og tekniske processer på tværs af vores services.
AI, udvikling og anvendelse Det forventes at du har erfaring med AI i tooling, anvendelse og kvalitetssikring. Det vil være en fordel med erfaring fra AI udviklingsprojekter, men ikke et krav.

Teknologier og værktøjer

Vores stack er Microsoft- centreret og inkluderer typisk:

Azure (Cloud development, Functions, integrationer, Service Bus, API Management, Redis Cache)
Cloud Architecture / platform design
Azure DevOps / CI/CD
.NET / C# og API design
Power Platform / Dynamics 365 (tæt samarbejde og integrationsflader)
Github Enterprise

Din profil

Vi forestiller os, at du:

Har solid erfaring med Azure og cloud arkitektur i praksis (gerne integrations-/platformfokus)
Har solid erfaring med C# / .NET
Har erfaring med API’er, integrationer og event‑baserede patterns
Har stærk forståelse for DevOps, CI/CD, automatisering og IaC
Kan kombinere arkitektur og rådgivning med evnen til at få ting til at ske i praksis

jobs.title: Commercial Domain Architect
jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
Are you a highly skilled architect who can turn complex commercial, digital, data and artificial intelligence choices into clear direction? Join Lundbeck as Commercial Domain Architect and help shape our commercial digital ecosystem.

In this role, you will be the design authority for the commercial digital domain across customer relationship management, customer engagement, omnichannel, content, analytics, commercial data and artificial intelligence-enabled workflows. You will help create a coherent ecosystem that can scale across markets while balancing global consistency, local relevance, speed, flexibility and long-term sustainability.

Your new role

As Commercial Domain Architect, you will own and evolve the target architecture for Lundbeck’s commercial digital domain, translating commercial priorities into clear architectural direction across platforms, integrations, data and future capabilities.

A key part of your role will be navigating complex trade-offs where there is rarely one perfect answer — for example global standardisation versus local flexibility, platform-native versus modular approaches, and speed of delivery versus long-term scalability.

You will work closely with the Head of Architecture & Design, solution architects, commercial stakeholders, colleagues across data, artificial intelligence, security and operations, and external partners. You will be a trusted sparring partner for the solution architects, helping them navigate design choices, challenge assumptions and keep solutions aligned with the broader commercial target architecture.

Your key responsibilities will include:

Shape the commercial architecture

Own and evolve the target architecture across customer relationship management, customer engagement, omnichannel, content, analytics, commercial data and artificial intelligence-enabled capabilities.
Define how customer, account, engagement, content, consent, insight and performance data connect across the commercial ecosystem.
Define platform boundaries, integration patterns and solution principles that enable interoperability, reuse and future flexibility across the organisation.

Provide strategic design authority

Act as the architectural design authority for the commercial domain and assess solution fit within agreed enterprise principles and guardrails.
Provide clear recommendations on strategic trade-offs and make the rationale understandable to both senior stakeholders and technical teams.
Identify and challenge designs that could create unnecessary duplication, technical debt, weak interoperability, vendor dependency or constraints on future scalability and innovation.

Enable data and artificial intelligence

Ensure the commercial architecture supports trusted, well-governed and artificial intelligence-ready data and insights.
Shape the architectural foundation for scalable artificial intelligence workflows and future artificial intelligence-enabled customer engagement.
Connect commercial architecture with wider enterprise capabilities across data, artificial intelligence, integration, security and operations.

Guide solutions from architecture to delivery

Act as a senior sparring partner for solution architects and guide external partners so detailed designs remain aligned with the commercial target architecture and agreed design principles.
Challenge technology and implementation partners on data models, integration, extensibility, compliance, scalability, vendor dependency and long-term cost.
Provide architectural recommendations and risk assessments that inform platform, vendor, investment and roadmap decisions.

Your future team

You will join the Architecture & Design team within Commercial Digital Enablement, part of Lundbeck’s Enterprise Digital Enablement organisation. The team connects commercial priorities with enterprise architecture and solution design, helping Lundbeck develop digital capabilities that can be reused and scaled across markets.

You will report to the Head of Architecture & Design. As Commercial Domain Architect, you will provide professional architecture authority for the commercial domain and act as a senior sparring partner for solution architects, the Delivery Lead and stakeholders across Commercial, Data, Artificial Intelligence, Security and Operations.

The position has no direct people-management responsibility, but you will have significant professional influence through your role as the architectural authority for the commercial digital domain.

The role is based at our headquarters in Copenhagen, Denmark. Given the collaborative and leadership nature of the role, frequent in-office presence is required.

What You Bring To The Team

We are looking for a highly talented architect who combines strong technical judgement with commercial understanding, pragmatic decision-making and excellent communication skills. You bring:

8+ years of experience in domain architecture, solution architecture, enterprise architecture or senior platform roles.
Strong understanding of commercial capabilities within life sciences, including customer relationship management, customer engagement, customer and account data, and analytics.
Experience shaping target architectures and designing scalable digital ecosystems across multiple markets or business units.
Strong understanding of data, artificial intelligence, integration, platform architecture and governance.
Experience assessing platform and ecosystem choices and challenging technology vendors and implementation partners.
The ability to assess complex architectural trade-offs and advise senior stakeholders in practical business language.
A collaborative working style, with the ability to build trust and create alignment across business, digital, data, artificial intelligence and technology teams.
The confidence to act as a constructive sparring partner for solution architects, helping translate architectural principles into practical solution design.
A strong enterprise mindset, with the ability to balance local requirements with scalability, interoperability and long-term sustainability.

Our promise to you

Lundbeck offers an inspiring workplace and innovative culture, where our curiosity, accountability and adaptability enable us to transform lives. We want to go faster and further in addressing the significant unmet needs of people living with brain disorders. We offer rewarding careers with exciting challenges and development opportunities, balanced with initiatives focused on your well-being.

Annual base salary range: 786 000 - 1 081 300 DKK gross

At Lundbeck, we are committed to fair and transparent pay. Please note that the final base salary within the stated range will be based on relevant qualifications, skills, competencies, and level of proficiency as well as internal pay equity.

We need every brain in the game, and at Lundbeck, we are committed to building a workforce that is as diverse as the people we serve. Read more about our commitment at www.lundbeck.com/global/about-us/our-commitment/diversity-and-inclusion.

Support Sales: Technical support during RFI, RFP requests...
Migration and Modernization: Lead and support the migration of on-premises workloads to Azure, as well as the modernization of existing cloud applications.
Cost Optimization: Continuously monitor and optimize Azure resource utilization to ensure cost efficiency.
Performance Monitoring and Optimization: Implement monitoring and alerting solutions to ensure high availability and performance of Azure services. Proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks.
Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity: Design and implement disaster recovery and business continuity plans for Azure-based solutions.
Documentation: Create and maintain detailed architecture diagrams, technical specifications, and operational documentation. 📄
Stay Current: Keep abreast of the latest Azure services, features, and industry trends.

Qualifications

Proven experience as a Cloud Architect, Solutions Architect, or a similar role with a strong focus on Microsoft Azure.
In-depth knowledge of core Azure services, including:
Compute (Virtual Machines, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), App Services, Azure Functions)
Storage (Blob Storage, Azure Files, Azure Disks, Azure NetApp Files)
Networking (Virtual Networks, Load Balancers, Application Gateway, Azure Firewall, ExpressRoute, VPN Gateway)
Databases (Azure SQL Database, Cosmos DB, Azure Database for PostgreSQL/MySQL)
Security (Azure Security Center, Azure Sentinel, Key Vault, Azure Active Directory)
Monitoring (Azure Monitor, Log Analytics)
Identity and Access Management (Azure AD, RBAC)
Hybrid Cloud (Azure Local, Azure Arc)
Cloud PC (AVD, Windows 365)

Strong understanding of cloud architecture principles, including microservices, serverless, and event-driven architectures.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (ARM templates, Bicep, Terraform).
Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., PowerShell, Azure CLI, Python).
Solid understanding of DevOps principles and CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions).
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills. 💡
Strong communication, collaboration, and presentation skills.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
Fluent in English and either French or Dutch, or both.

Desired Qualifications:

Microsoft Azure certifications, e.g. 🏅:
AZ-305: Designing Microsoft Azure Infrastructure Solutions,
AZ-400: Designing and Implementing Microsoft DevOps Solutions,
SC-300: Identity and Access Administrator Associate,
AI-102, Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate).

Experience with hybrid cloud environments.
Knowledge of containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
Familiarity with other cloud platforms (AWS, GCP) is a plus.
Experience in specific industries (e.g.finance, healthcare) can be an advantage

#techies in our minds, #creatives in our hearts, #change in our DNA.

Description

Senior Systems Developer

At B&A, we foster and embrace a distinct set of values that we live by and instill in all aspects of our organization: dedication, commitment, partnership, trust, and recognition. We have incorporated these values into successful delivery for our customers since 1988. B&A believes in ensuring its employees feel deeply connected to B&A, recognizing successes and hard work, and providing continuous opportunities to learn and grow. Our people are entrepreneurial thinkers that combine mindset, vision, and experience to drive value – not only to us as an organization, but to the clients we support. We promote a collaborative culture with our clients, and with each other, as one team working towards a common vision. We’d love for you to join our team!

Job Summary

B&A is looking for a Senior Systems Developer in support of the Defense Health Agency (DHA) Care and Benefits Integrated Systems (CBIS) Program Management Office on an important mission. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with a great team while supporting the sustainment and modernization of DHA’s Enterprise Information Management (EIM) platform, an OpenText-based enterprise content and business process management platform, hosted in AWS GovCloud, that supports Military Health System application workflows including HAIMS, SPORTS, SNPMIS, Paper Records Tracking, FILER, and DMACS for service members, veterans, and their families. You will serve as the technical expert for designing, building, testing, and debugging application workflows and enhancements on the platform, working in an agile team that releases to production every three weeks. This is a full-time key personnel position based in the National Capital Region, with the ability to reach the Government site in Falls Church, VA within two hours, contingent upon contract award.

Responsibilities

Serve as the technical expert in the design, development, coding, testing, and debugging of new EIM application workflows and enhancements.
Work with the Government and its support teams to understand and resolve application issues, and respond to requests for modifications or enhancements.
Participate in application workflow development activities and coordinate technical requirements with the customer.
Develop and configure workflows using OpenText AppWorks, Content Server, and Government-owned code in a multi-tenant healthcare platform.
Deliver user stories through the agile sprint cycle: sprint planning, development, developer integration testing, demos, and retrospectives, using Government-furnished tools.
Analyze, fix, and close trouble tickets in ServiceNow, and support after-hours production issues and weekend deployments as needed.
Build and maintain standards-based interfaces (e.g., HL7, IHE XDR/XCA, FHIR, web services), including migration of interfaces to MuleSoft.
Support COTS upgrades, IAVA patches, and security remediation, keeping delivered code free of CAT I and CAT II security findings.
Use AI tools and techniques to reduce development time, improve deployments, and reduce defects.
Deliver source code and documentation, and update technical design documents, interface control documents, and data dictionaries with each release.

Education And Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems Management, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field.
Minimum of ten (10) years of technical experience related to Health IT.

Required Skills

Demonstrated experience developing DoD systems using the DoD agile development process (DoDI 5000.02).
Demonstrated technical expertise in application and business process development.
Experience using Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies to reduce development time, improve deployments, and reduce defects.
Knowledge of computer concepts and techniques to develop and apply automated solutions to engineering, scientific, or business data acquisition and management problems.

Desired Skills

Experience implementing large-scale OpenText Content Suite, AppWorks, and Archive Center.
Experience with healthcare interoperability standards (HL7, FHIR, IHE, DICOM).
Experience with MuleSoft, Salesforce, or AWS GovCloud.
Experience with the Defense Health Agency or Military Health System.

Security Clearance

No security clearance required. This is a Public Trust position.
Must be able to obtain and maintain a favorably adjudicated background investigation for an ADP/IT-I or ADP/IT-II position designation (Tier 5 or Tier 3), and a DoD Common Access Card (CAC).
Must complete DoD/DHA-required HIPAA and Privacy Act training and sign a DHA Non-Disclosure Agreement before starting work.

Physical & Work Environment Requirements

Employees must be able to perform the essential functions of this position, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Ability to remain stationary for extended periods while working at a computer.
Frequently operate standard office equipment, including computers and telephones.
Ability to communicate effectively in person, by telephone, video conference, and email.
Occasionally move about the office and lift up to 20 pounds.
Ability to work the assigned schedule with regular and reliable attendance.
Ability to travel up to 10% as required.

More About B&A

Notable Clients

B&A has grown to be a company that is trusted by our clients for exceptional service, innovative solutions, and inspired employees. Our service extends through federal, state, and local Government, the private sector, and higher education. Some of our notable clients include Department of Homeland Security, U.S. Customs and Border Protection, U.S. Senate, U.S. Courts, U.S. Census Bureau, U.S. Navy, and more.

Benefits and Programs

B&A is proud to offer three robust individual and family medical plans to full time employees, including a Health Savings Account (HSA) option as well as two tiers of dental coverage, vision, life & AD&D, disability, accident, hospital indemnity, and critical illness insurance. In addition to these benefits, B&A employees enjoy paid time off, B&A sponsored trainings and certifications, pet insurance benefits, commuter transit benefits and a free subscription to a virtual exercise platform (NEOU). B&A’s 401(k) plan is available to all employees and includes a company matching contribution.

B&A has launched several programs to focus on employee engagement, wellness, and assistance. These include:

The B&A Cares program: 30/60/90-day wellness check ins, personal development, financial management, and stress management seminars, and more
A formal mentorship program
Job shadowing and cross training opportunities
Brand Ambassador program
Employee Assistance Program (EAP) - Access to various support resources to include counseling, legal guidance, financial planning, and more
Monthly teambuilding events
B&A Annual Wellness Challenges: #StepWithB&A, #WalkDuringLunchWithB&A, #VolunteeringWithB&A, #ExerciseDuringLunchWithB&A, and more

At B&A, we place significant importance on improving the communities and lives of citizens across the nation through our involvement, technology expertise, and employees. B&A puts an emphasis on charitable efforts in the Northern Virginia area, including Capital Area Food Bank pantry drives, book donations, Hope for Henry Foundation events, and many more. In recognition of all these efforts, B&A has been named a Companies as Responsive Employers (CARE) award recipient by Northern Virginia Family Services and nominated by the Northern Virginia Chamber of Commerce for Outstanding Corporate Citizenship Award.

EEO

B&A provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, amnesty, or status as a covered veteran in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws. B&A complies with applicable state and local laws governing non-discrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy covers conduct occurring at B&A’s offices, and other workplaces (including client sites) and all other locations where B&A is providing services, and to all work-related activities.

EEO is the Law

B&A participates in e-Verify. We provide the Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) with information from each new employee’s I-9 Form to confirm work authorization.

WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK

jobs.title: Senior Data Architect, Scientific Data Platform
jobs.description:
Job Description

Agilent instruments produce the measurements behind pharmaceutical quality control, food and environmental testing, and research labs worldwide. That data sits in dozens of software products, and we are building a platform that lets our products, our customers' workflows, and AI agents find and use it wherever it lives.

We are hiring a data architect to own the discovery and access side of that platform: how scientific data is registered and found, and how it is composed and served. The platform architecture is established; the target state for discovery and access, and the path to it, are yours to define.

You work under the Lead Data Architect, who owns cross-service standards and governance. Within your areas, the architecture decisions are yours; cross-service decisions go to the Lead with evidence, options, and a recommendation.

This is an architecture role with hands-on evidence: you decide the architecture for your areas, stay with engineering through implementation, and read the code, run the queries, and build the proof of concept when an argument needs one.

Your areas:

Data access. Your part of the federated GraphQL gateway, which the platform team owns how connected systems are represented on it, directly or through data services; the read layer that composes results across systems; and the application data services that expose access-controlled views of scientific data to products, workflows, and AI consumers.
Catalog and search. The catalog record model, how connected systems register their data and how that metadata is represented, search over it, and the path to richer indexes like vector and graph.

Access is the first-year priority; catalog work runs alongside as the first connectors land. File management, metadata extraction, and semantic standards are owned by other architects on the team. The data is scientific data created by software products: results, methods, samples, files. ERP, CRM, and other enterprise business systems are out of scope.

What you will do:

Establish how the catalog and access paths behave today and define the target state: service boundaries, contracts, integration patterns, and the path between the two.
Own the schemas and contracts your areas depend on: catalog records, subgraph boundaries, data service views, and versioned event schemas. Design them and make explicit which system is authoritative for each piece of information under the program's data governance rules, and version them so existing consumers keep working.
Design the access paths AI agents use to read what they can, under what controls, and with what provenance.
Review proposed integrations against your contracts and the program's participation requirements. Change your contracts when the evidence warrants and propose changes to the requirements.
Design modernization paths for legacy sources that keep customers running through the transition, including moves from on-premises to hybrid or cloud.
Set query and index performance targets for catalog and access paths.
Design the pipelines that keep the catalog, the search index, and the access views current as data arrives, from extractor output through backfill and recovery.
Work directly with engineering: clarify designs, evaluate implementation plans, review delivered work against the decisions.
Write the decision records and diagrams for your areas, and explain the tradeoffs to engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders.

What we work with:

.NET (C#) services, Angular front ends, and a federated GraphQL gateway
PostgreSQL by default, with Oracle and SQL Server across the installed base
RabbitMQ for messaging and event-driven change discovery
Kubernetes and Helm alongside Windows installers for on-premises and hybrid customers, with S3-compatible object storage
Scientific data in proprietary instrument formats as well as vendor-neutral formats like Allotrope
AI assistants in daily use

Qualifications

Required qualifications:

Has 8+ years in software engineering, data engineering, or architecture with distributed systems: service boundaries, APIs, and event-driven integration.
Has defined architecture ahead of finalized standards and governance and can show which decisions held up and which had to change.
Has owned the architecture of a production system in at least one of these areas: data catalogs and metadata management (DataHub, OpenMetadata, or similar); search and indexing (Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, or similar); API or federated-query data access layers (Apollo Federation, or similar); or the data layer of a scientific, laboratory, or regulated application.
Writes SQL and reads execution plans in PostgreSQL or SQL Server.
Has built and run data pipelines, including recovery and backfill.
Reads production code in a typed language (C#, Java, TypeScript, or similar) and can build a proof of concept.
Uses AI tools in daily architecture and data work (profiling and cleaning data, reading and generating code, drafting decision records) and can show the process: what you delegate, what you verify, and how.
Works across product, engineering, and business teams without direct authority.

Preferred qualifications:

Has delivered data products consumed by applications: APIs, views, or datasets that other software depends on.
Working knowledge of catalog, search, and data access beyond the area you have owned.
Laboratory informatics or regulated life sciences, including data integrity and audit trail expectations.
Architecture decision records, C4 or similar diagrams, and interface contracts.
Cloud integration patterns (identity, storage, messaging, managed data services) alongside on-premises deployment.

Additional Details

This job has a full time weekly schedule. It includes the option to work remotely.

Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. During the hiring process, a recruiter can share more about the specific pay range for a preferred location. Pay and benefit information by country are available at: https://careers.agilent.com/locations

Elegir Capgemini significa elegir una empresa donde tendrás la libertad de diseñar tu carrera profesional como desees, con el respaldo y la inspiración de una comunidad colaborativa de colegas en todo el mundo. Aquí podrás reinventar lo que es posible. Únete a nosotros y ayuda a las organizaciones líderes en el mundo a descubrir el valor de la tecnología y construir un mundo más sostenible e inclusivo.

Tenemos un equipo de Data & AI que estará encantado de contar contigo. ¿Te apetece sumarte?

¿Cuál será tu rol?

Buscamos un perfil de AI Solution Architect con capacidad para definir, evolucionar y acompañar técnicamente arquitecturas de aplicaciones que contengan IA. Se requiere una combinación equilibrada entre visión arquitectónica, capacidad técnica real (“hands-on”) y acompañamiento a equipos de desarrollo y operación. La posición participará activamente en iniciativas de modernización tecnológica, arquitecturas cloud-native, automatización y mejora continua de plataformas y aplicaciones.

Algunas de las funciones del rol incluyen:

Diseño y evolución de arquitectura de soluciones: Definir, analizar y evolucionar arquitecturas de aplicaciones y sistemas distribuidos, asegurando su alineamiento con requisitos funcionales, no funcionales, de seguridad, resiliencia, escalabilidad y mantenibilidad.
Definición de modelos y vistas de arquitectura: Elaboración y mantenimiento de documentación y diseños de arquitectura a diferentes niveles y perspectivas.
Arquitectura Cloud y despliegue: Diseño de soluciones sobre plataformas cloud públicas (AWS y Azure), utilizando servicios gestionados, arquitecturas desacopladas y principios cloud-native.
Desarrollo y acompañamiento técnico: Participación activa en la implementación de componentes críticos y acompañamiento técnico a los equipos de desarrollo, promoviendo buenas prácticas de ingeniería, calidad de código y patrones de diseño.
Seguridad y cumplimiento: Incorporar principios de Security by Design y asegurar el cumplimiento de estándares técnicos, requisitos corporativos y controles de seguridad.
Observabilidad y operación: Definir mecanismos de monitorización, trazabilidad y observabilidad que permitan garantizar la fiabilidad, operabilidad y diagnóstico de las soluciones desplegadas.
Optimización y mejora continua: Evaluar y mejorar continuamente el rendimiento, resiliencia, eficiencia operativa y escalabilidad de las soluciones tecnológicas.

Tu perfil

Para desenvolverte bien en la posición se requieren las siguientes habilidades:

Diseño y definición de arquitecturas para PoCs de IA (RAG y Multiagentes).
Evaluación técnica de alternativas y tecnologías.
Desarrollo de prototipos en Python.
Desarrollo en plataforma de datos (Databricks).
Machine Learning e IA Generativa.
Soporte técnico al equipo de desarrollo de PoCs.
Interlocución con negocio para definir casos de uso.
Participación en demostradores y aceleradores de innovación.
Diseño de arquitecturas basadas en microservicios y APIs.
Experiencia en despliegues sobre cloud público (AWS y Azure).
Conocimiento de servicios cloud-native y serverless.
Experiencia en CI/CD y automatización de pipelines.
Conocimientos de observabilidad y monitorización.
Conocimientos de seguridad aplicada a arquitecturas cloud.
Conocimiento de patrones de resiliencia y escalabilidad.
Experiencia en troubleshooting técnico y soporte a incidencias complejas.
Comunicación y capacidad de interlocución, liderazgo técnico, autonomia y proactividad.

Valoraremos todas las candidaturas. Contamos con una amplísima oferta formativa, presencial, online de Certificaciones, etc. Aunque no tengas el 100% de los conocimientos valorados ¡nos encantará conocerte!

Nuestro compromiso con la inclusión e igualdad de oportunidades hace que tengamos un Plan de Igualdad y un Código Ético que garantizan el desarrollo profesional de la plantilla y la igualdad de oportunidades en su selección dentro de un entorno libre de discriminación por cuestión de etnia, nacionalidad, origen social, edad, orientación sexual, expresión de género, religión o cualquier otra circunstancia personal, física o social.

¿Qué te gustará de trabajar aquí?

Tenemos un catálogo de medidas de Desarrollo y Conciliación muy completo, como son, por ejemplo:

Plan de Compensación Flexible (tickets guardería, seguro médico, tarjeta restaurante o subvención de comida, transporte, formación…)
Modelo de teletrabajo híbrido y flexible.
24 días de vacaciones + 2 asuntos propios + 24 y 31 de diciembre + opción a comprar hasta 7 días de vacaciones al año.
FlexAbroad: posibilidad de trabajar en remoto desde otro país durante 45 días.
Formación continua. Acceso a itinerarios de formación completos con oportunidades de certificación. Tendrás acceso gratuito a plataformas como: Coursera, Udemy, Pluralsight, Harvard Manager Mentor, Education First para idiomas …
Wellbeing HUB - Incluye políticas y acciones para la salud física y mental.
Participación en acciones de voluntariado y acción social con nuestros grupos de Sostenibilidad, Inclusión e Igualdad.

¿Por qué Capgemini?

Capgemini es líder global en transformar los negocios de los clientes aprovechando todo el poder de la tecnología. Nos guía el propósito de lograr un futuro inclusivo y sostenible a través de la tecnología y de la energía de quienes la desarrollamos. Somos una compañía responsable y diversa, líder internacional en servicios de IT e Ingeniería con más de 360.000 profesionales en más de 50 países. Con una sólida herencia de 55 años y una amplia experiencia en la industria, los clientes confían en Capgemini para abordar la totalidad de sus necesidades comerciales, desde la estrategia y el diseño hasta las operaciones, impulsadas por el rápido y novedoso mundo de la nube, los datos, la IA, la conectividad, el software, las plataformas e ingeniería digitales.

Reescribe tu futuro. ¡Únete al equipo!

jobs.title: Expert Manager, Software Engineering  (Full Stack)
jobs.description:
Please submit your application in English

Application Deadline, September 30

WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work

list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

You’ll join our Engineering experts within the AI, Insights & Solutions 
team
. This team is part of Bain’s digital capabilities practice, which includes experts in analytics, engineering, product management, and design. In this multidisciplinary environment, you'll leverage deep technical expertise with business acumen to help clients tackle their most transformative challenges. You’ll work on integrated teams alongside our general consultants and clients to develop data-driven strategies and innovative solutions. Together, we create human-centric solutions that harness the power of data and artificial intelligence to drive competitive advantage for our clients. Our collaborative and supportive work environment fosters creativity and continuous learning, enabling us to consistently deliver exceptional results.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 As an Expert Manager, Software Engineering, you will lead the development and building of software applications that address complex business and technology problems in various industries. You will guide a diverse engineering team through the entire engineering life cycle. Your responsibilities will include designing, developing, optimizing, and deploying cutting-edge software engineering solutions and infrastructure at the production scale required by the world’s largest companies, with a strong focus on ensuring technical delivery supports business strategy, operating model evolution, and sustainable value creation.
Shape & scope client solutions. Work with Bain consulting teams and product owners to translate business problems into prioritized backlogs and technical roadmaps for cross-functional engineering squads
Translate technical capabilities into client-ready product and transformation outcomes by shaping product direction, operating model implications, and change management approaches that support adoption and measurable business impact
Own full-stack design & build. Lead the architecture, development and documentation of AI applications, including coding and integrating third-party services or frameworks that accelerate delivery and long-term maintainability
Establish AI-native software engineering best practices. Define and enforce standards around component libraries/design systems, automated testing, linting, CI/CD, accessibility and performance optimization
Develop reusable libraries & accelerators. Create and curate shared code assets that reduce time-to-value across multiple client projects and internal initiatives.
Lead the full delivery lifecycle. Set quality gates, supervise code reviews, ensure robust unit/integration test coverage, manage release planning, and oversee post-deployment monitoring and incident resolution
Partner on UI/UX excellence. Collaborate with designers to ship inclusive, responsive interfaces
Mentor & grow engineers. Provide day-to-day technical coaching for senior and mid-level engineers through pair programming, architecture sessions and constructive feedback
Upskill client engineering teams. Coach client developers on modern tooling and DevOps/cloud-native practices, ensuring sustainable ownership after Bain’s engagement
Advance AI-native technology adoption. Champion containerization, infrastructure-as-code, automated observability and secure-by-design principles to improve scalability, reliability and security
Contribute to communities of practice. Share lessons learned and emerging technology trends through internal forums, brown-bag sessions and knowledge assets
Support talent acquisition & onboarding. Participate in interviewing, technical assessments and mentoring of new hires to build a high-caliber engineering cohort
Travel is required. This position requires regional travel away from your home office/primary working location. Travel frequency and destinations will vary based on project needs

ABOUT YOU

Technical Skills & Knowledge

Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
6+ years of end-to-end experience designing, building and maintaining production-grade full-stack applications
Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate strategic objectives into solution, platform products or roadmaps
4+ years building server-side services using FastAPI, Node.js/Express, Flask, Django, .NET Core or Java Spring Boot or similar technologies, including the design of APIs
3+ years of architecting and operating micro-service ecosystems, emphasizing service discovery, observability, CI/CD automation and blue-/green or canary deployments
Expert knowledge of Python, JavaScript and/or other programming languages
Experience with cloud-native delivery on AWS, Azure or GCP, knowledge of managed services, serverless patterns and infrastructure-as-code such as Terraform, CloudFormation or Bicep
Proficient with containerization and orchestration, Docker, Kubernetes and related tooling (Helm, Argo CD)
Experience with database architecture across relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server) and NoSQL/document stores (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis), with solid SQL skills

Solid computer science fundamentals, data structures, algorithms, object-oriented and functional paradigms, automated testing, performance profiling

Excellence in software architecture design, including modular, distributed, and cloud-native systems, scalability, resiliency, maintainability, and observability
Experience with data security, OAuth 2.0/OIDC, JWT, SSO/cloud IAM, encryption in transit, at rest, and awareness of data protection regulations.
Ideally, experience with modern AI/ML development, working with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, agentic SDKs and AI safety
Ideally, hands-on experience with modern web technologies such as React, Angular, Vue.js, TypeScript, HTML5 and CSS3
Proven leader and mentor with ability to lead engineering squads, set coding standards, perform rigorous code reviews and up skill junior engineers.
Agile delivery mindset, practical experience with Scrum or Kanban, story-point estimation, backlog grooming and the use of Git-based workflows, Jira and automated CI/CD pipelines.
Fluency in English. Minimum business fluent Spanish for Iberia

Interpersonal Skills

Strong interpersonal and communication skills, including the ability to explain and discuss technicalities of solutions, algorithms and techniques with colleagues and clients from other disciplines
Curiosity, proactivity and critical thinking
Ability to collaborate with people at all levels and with multi-office/region teams 
Ability to work independently and juggle priorities to thrive in a fast paced and ambiguous environment, while also collaborating as part of a team in complex situations
